blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Photospheric vector magnetic fields are foundational to modeling, understanding, and forecasting solar activity. These data are usually produced by inverting and disambiguating the full Stokes vector at multiple passbands, which is demanding. Here, we investigate how well we can estimate photospheric vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. This problem is challenging and intrinsically ambiguous without polarization information, as the mapping from UV/EUV intensity to the magnetic field is indirect and ill-posed. We introduce MAGiDiff , a machine-learning-based method that uses denoising diffusion models to estimate vector magnetograms from UV/EUV filtergrams. As input, MAGiDiff takes a stack of filtergrams from the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) / Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA); as output, it is trained to estimate the disambiguated vector magnetogram as seen by Hinode / Solar Optical Telescope-Spectro-Polarimeter (SOT-SP). We show that MAGiDiff can accurately mimic the Hinode ground truth. Additionally, we probe MAGiDiff ’s understanding of the physical structure and magnetic connectivity. On full-disk, we show that it produces plausible structures for active regions. MAGiDiff generalizes across solar cycles despite hemispheric polarity reversal, and can be fine-tuned to other EUV instruments including STEREO /EUVI and GOES-R /SUVI. While clearly not a substitute for a dedicated instrument, MAGiDiff opens the door to new capabilities.
blocks.zh: 平流层矢量磁场是太阳活动建模、理解和预测的基础。 这些数据通常是通过颠倒和分解多个通过带的全斯托克斯向量来生成的,这要求很高. 在这里,我们调查我们如何能从紫外线/欧盟紫外线滤波仪中 估算出光球矢量磁力图。 这个问题具有挑战性,而且内在含糊不清,没有两极分化信息,因为从紫外线/欧盟紫外线强度到磁场的绘图是间接的,而且不正确。 我们引入了MAGiDiff,一种基于机器学习的方法,它使用去诺化扩散模型来估计紫外线/欧盟紫外线滤波图中的矢量磁学。 作为输入,MAGiDiff从太阳动力学观测台/大气成像仪(AIA)中提取一叠滤镜;作为输出,它被训练来估计Hinode /太阳光学望远镜-Spectro-Polarimeter(SOT-SP)所看到的离散的矢量磁图. 我们显示MagiDiff能够准确模仿Hinode地面的真相. 此外,我们探索MagiDiff对物理结构和磁力连通性的理解。 在全磁盘上,我们显示,它为活跃地区提供了可信的结构。 MAGiDiff在半球极性逆转的情况下,将太阳各周期进行通缩,并可以被微调成其他的EUV仪器,包括STEREO/EUVI和GOES-R/SUVI. 虽然显然不能替代专用仪器,但MAGiDiff打开了新能力的大门.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
In solar physics, high-quality photospheric vector magnetic field measurements underpin our understanding of many solar activities, including space weather forecasting [ 4 , 3 , 2 , 41 ] , coronal magnetic structure modeling and magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulation [ 69 , 32 ] , and the evolution of the Sun’s atmosphere [ 42 , 7 , 12 , 46 , 17 , 22 , 60 ] .
However, estimating vector magnetograms usually requires sampling the full Stokes vector (i.e., [ I , Q , U , V I,Q,U,V ]) at multiple wavelengths. These signals are difficult to acquire, especially the linear polarization components Q Q and U U [ 63 ] .
As a result, vector magnetograms can be limited in cadence, coverage, or availability across missions. This motivates a complementary approach: evaluating how well vector magnetograms can be estimated from other more widely available observations. Such estimates cannot replace spectropolarimetric measurements, but a reliable estimate would extend the use of existing data archives and provide magnetic field context in settings where direct vector measurements are not available.
blocks.zh:
在太阳物理学中,高质量的光球矢量磁场测量使我们了解许多太阳活动,包括空间天气预报[4、3、2、41]、日冕磁力结构模型和磁力动力学模拟[69、32],以及太阳大气的演变[42、7、12、46、17、22、60]。
然而,估计矢量磁学通常需要用多个波长对全斯托克斯矢量(即[I,Q,U,V I,Q,U,V])进行取样. 这些信号难以获得,尤其是线性极化组件QQ和U U[63].
因此,矢量磁学在各特派团的粗糙度、覆盖面或可用性方面可能受到限制。 这激励了一种补充方法:评价如何能从其他更广泛的观测中估算矢量磁图。 这种估计不能取代光谱极度测量,但可靠的估计将扩大现有数据档案的使用范围,并在没有直接矢量测量的情况下提供磁场环境。

blocks.en: UV/EUV intensity maps are a natural starting point because they are abundant and are routinely collected by a broader set of instruments, many of which do not carry spectropolarimeters. Instruments like the Atmospheric Imaging Assembly (AIA; [ 43 ] ) on SDO, the Extreme Ultraviolet Imager (EUVI; [ 71 ] ) on the twin Solar Terrestrial Relationship Observatory (STEREO; [ 34 ] ), the Extreme Ultraviolet Imager (EUI; [ 53 ] ) on Solar Orbiter (SO; [ 50 ] ), and the Solar UltraViolet Imager (SUVI; [ 8 ] ) on the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellites (GOES-R series; [ 25 ] ) deliver high-cadence, full-disk, multi-wavelength observations of the corona over decades.
blocks.zh: 紫外线/EUV强度图是一个自然的起点,因为这些图很丰富,通常由更广泛的一组仪器收集,其中许多没有带光谱极度。 诸如大气成像仪(AIA;[43])在SDO、极端紫外线成像仪(EUVI;[71])在双太阳地面关系观测台(STEREO;[34])上、极端紫外线成像仪(EUI;[53])在太阳轨道器(SO;[50])上和太阳超紫外线成像仪(SUVI;[8])在地球静止运行环境卫星(GOES-R系列);[25]在几十年内进行高密度、全磁盘、多波长观测。

blocks.en:
Unfortunately, there is a fundamentally ambiguous and statistical relationship between UV/EUV intensity and the photospheric magnetic field. First, if one were to flip the field consistently, one would observe identical intensity images (in addition to the 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} plane-of-sky ambiguity described by [ 21 ] ). Second, most of the UV/EUV light does not originate at the photosphere.
Yet, while the relationship is less direct than in Stokes inversion, there is signal. For instance, the known statistical relationship between unsigned flux and intensity [ 59 ] has been used to derive total flux from 304Å data [ 65 , 38 ] . Similarly, due to the low plasma- β \beta of the corona, filtergrams originating in the corona (e.g., 171Å) trace out magnetic field lines that head down to the photosphere. However, each observation provides an indirect cue that needs to be integrated to constrain the possible photospheric field.
blocks.zh:
不幸的是,紫外线/EUV强度与光圈磁场之间存在着根本的模糊和统计关系。 首先,如果人们要始终如一地翻转球场,就会看到相同的强度图像(除了[21]描述的180 ∘180 ^{\circ}平面-of-sky的模糊性外). 第二,大部分紫外/EUV光不是源于光圈.
然而,虽然这种关系不如斯托克斯反演中那么直接,但还是有信号的. 例如,利用无符号通量和强度之间的已知统计关系[59]从304 数据中得出总通量[65,38]。 同样,由于日冕的等离子体-β\β,源自日冕的滤镜(如171Å)追踪到向下到光圈的磁场线. 然而,每一项观测都提供了一个间接提示,需要加以整合以限制可能的光球场.

blocks.en: While the polarity ambiguity is intrinsic, it can be empirically mitigated with additional context. Hale’s law [ 19 ] states that the leading polarity of bipolar active regions is opposite in the northern and southern hemispheres, and this pattern reverses between consecutive solar cycles. Given heliographic latitude and solar cycle information as input, a model can often infer the polarity without the need for polarization measurements.
blocks.zh: 虽然极性模糊性是内在的,但可以通过更多的上下文从经验上减轻。 Hale的定律[19]指出,两极活动区域的主要极性在北半球和南半球是相反的,这种模式在连续的太阳周期之间发生逆转. 鉴于直升机纬度和太阳周期信息作为投入,一个模型往往可以推断极性,而无需进行两极化测量。

blocks.en: These observations motivate MAGiDiff , a learning-based framework that maps UV/EUV filtergrams to heliographic vector magnetic flux density components α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} (where the α \alpha denotes that the quantity includes both intrinsic field strength and filling fraction α \alpha ). MAGiDiff takes input from SDO /AIA, due to its mission archive of 15+ years of nearly-complete, high-quality, filtergrams. MAGiDiff is built on denoising diffusion models, a recent advance in machine learning that has produced remarkable results in conditional image generation. Unlike regression models that predict a single estimate, diffusion models learn to sample from a distribution of possible predictions, producing sharper outputs and enabling uncertainty estimation. MAGiDiff is trained to estimate magnetic flux density from Hinode /SOT-SP observations resampled to the SDO /HMI sampling grid. One reason for using Hinode /SOT-SP is entirely practical: its dense sampling of two absorption lines yields high-quality magnetograms, which enhances the overall quality of MAGiDiff ’s output. The other is forward-looking: Hinode /SOT-SP captures only a limited field of view, but many sources of high-quality data will also be non-full disk, like PHI [ 61 ] for magnetograms outside the Sun-Earth line.
blocks.zh: 这些观测激发了MAGiDiff, 一个基于学习的框架,将紫外线/EUV滤波图映射到直升机矢量磁通密度的成份α B R\ alpha B_{R}、α B → alpha B_{\phi} 和α B → alpha B_{\theta} (其中α α α 表示数量既包括内在的场强度,也包括填充分数α\α\pha)。 MAGiDiff从SDO/AIA接收输入,因为其任务存档为15年以上,几乎完成,高质量,滤镜. MAGiDiff是建立在去诺斯化扩散模型之上的,这是最近在机器学习方面的进步,在有条件的图像生成中产生了显著的成果. 与预测单一估计数的回归模型不同的是,扩散模型学习从可能的预测分布中取样,产生更锐利的输出,并促成不确定性估计. MAGiDiff接受过从Hinode /SOT-SP观测重印到SDO /HMI取样网格的磁通量密度估计训练. 使用Hinode /SOT-SP的一个原因是完全实用的:它密集的取样两条吸收线产生高质量的磁图,这提高了MAGiDiff输出的整体质量. 另一个是前瞻性的:Hinode / SOT-SP只捕捉到一个有限的视野,但许多高质量的数据来源也会是非全磁盘,如PHI [61]用于太阳地线外的磁图.

blocks.en: We evaluate MAGiDiff on several tests. First, we show its performance on previously unseen regions, including across solar cycles. Second, we probe MAGiDiff ’s ability to model the correlations in the vector field by analyzing its predicted distribution. Third, we test the model’s generalization ability on full-disk inputs. Finally, we show that MAGiDiff can be fine-tuned to other instruments like STEREO /EUVI, GOES–16 /SUVI, and GOES–18 /SUVI, demonstrating a path toward supplemental vector field estimation from missions without spectropolarimeters. While not a substitute for a dedicated facility that captures spectropolarimetric data and inverts it to produce vector magnetograms, we believe that MAGiDiff presents an opportunity to get more from existing data.
blocks.zh: 我们对MAGiDiff的几项测试进行评估。 首先,我们在以前未见的区域,包括在太阳周期内显示其性能。 第二,我们探索MagiDiff通过分析矢量域的预测分布来模拟其相关性的能力。 第三,我们在全盘输入上测试模型的通用能力. 最后,我们显示,MAGiDiff可以被微调成其他仪器,如STEREO/EUVI、GOES–16/SUVI和GOES–18/SUVI,这显示了从没有分光极的飞行任务中得出补充矢量场估计的途径。 虽然不能取代专门收集光谱极度测量数据并反转其生成矢量磁图的设施,但我们认为,MAGiDiff提供了一个从现有数据中获得更多数据的机会。

blocks.en: II Data
blocks.zh: 二. 数据

blocks.en: This work tackles the task of estimating possible Hinode /SOT-SP vector magnetograms from UV/EUV data obtained from SDO /AIA. A full description of the data involved is beyond the scope of the paper, but we give a brief description to make the paper more self-contained.
blocks.zh: 这项工作涉及从SDO/AIA获得的紫外线/EUV数据中估算Hinode/SOT-SP矢量磁力图的任务。 全面描述所涉数据超出了文件的范围,但我们作一个简短的描述,以使文件更加自足。

blocks.en:
The input data from SDO /AIA consist of high-cadence, high-resolution filtergram observations, grouped in EUV (94Å, 131Å, 171Å, 193Å, 211Å, 304Å, 335Å) and UV (1600Å, 1700Å) filters. We do not use SDO /AIA’s visible light observation (at 4500Å). Each filter has a characteristic temperature and height at which much of the light is emitted.
These filtergrams are captured near-synchronously at 4096 × 4096 4096\times 4096 with 0.6 ​ ″ 0.6\arcsec sampling and approximately 1.5 ​ ″ 1.5\arcsec optical resolution. We use the aia.lev1_euv_12s and aia.lev1_uv_24s series, corrected for exposure time and filter degradation following [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
来自SDO/AIA的输入数据包括高频高分辨率滤波仪观测,分类为EUV(94Å,131Å,171Å,193Å,211Å,304Å,335Å)和UV(1600Å,1700Å)滤波仪. 我们没有使用SDO/AIA的可见光观测(at 4500). 每个过滤器都有一个特征温度和高度,大部分光都是在这种高度发射的。
这些滤波克在4096×4096 4096\times 4096上几乎同步地被捕获,其0.6×0.6×arcsec采样,约1.5×1.5×arcsec光学分辨率. 我们使用 aia.lev1_euv_12s 和 aia.lev1_uv_24s 系列, 修正暴露时间 和过滤降解 之后 [15] 。

blocks.en: The output data are from Hinode /SOT-SP, a scanning-slit spectropolarimeter that sweeps a slit across a scene, capturing dense Stokes profiles of two photospheric spectral lines at a spatial sampling of 0.16 ​ ″ 0.16\arcsec . Each scan covers roughly 160 ​ ″ 160\arcsec along the slit with varying scan width, and typically takes about an hour to complete. This dense sampling yields higher-quality vector magnetograms than those from SDO /HMI. The vector magnetic field is estimated from these data with a Stokes inversion technique [ 47 ] , followed by ME0 disambiguation [ 49 ] to yield the 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} -disambiguated [ 21 ] heliographic components.
blocks.zh: 输出数据来自Hinode / SOT-SP,一个扫描光谱极度计,它横扫一个场景,在0.16~0.16\arcsec的空间采样中捕捉两个光球光谱线的密集的斯托克斯剖面. 每次扫描大约覆盖160~160\arcsec沿断裂,扫描宽度不一,一般需要约一个小时才能完成. 这种密集采样产生的矢量磁力图的质量高于来自SDO/HMI的磁力图。 从这些数据中估算出矢量磁场,采用Stokes反射技术[47],然后是ME0分解[49],以产生180 ∘ 180^{\circ} - 分解[21]的直升机组件。

blocks.en:
The data are prepared as a co-aligned cutout volume of SDO /AIA filtergrams and Hinode /SOT-SP vector magnetograms. We co-align to the frame of the Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager, HMI [ 58 ] to take advantage of the co-alignments of Hinode /SOT-SP and SDO /HMI done by [ 67 ] that account for a pointing error in Hinode /SOT-SP data [ 13 ] . We likewise align the SDO /AIA data to this grid. While Hinode /SOT-SP takes tens of minutes to acquire a scan (resulting in intrinsic temporal misalignment), we let the method handle potential mismatch rather than handle it in data alignment.
In addition to the UV/EUV filtergrams, we provide a polarity prior consisting of per-pixel heliographic latitude and a solar cycle indicator ( 1 1 for odd cycles and − 1 -1 for even cycles) as auxiliary inputs, both derived from the SDO /AIA FITS headers. This prior supplies the positional and temporal context needed to leverage Hale’s law for polarity inference.
blocks.zh:
这些数据是作为SDO/AIA滤波图和Hinode/SOT-SP矢量磁力图的协同剪切量编制的。 我们与Heliosemic和Magnetic Inmigr, HMI [58] 的帧对齐,利用Hinode /SOT-SP和SDO/HMI的共同对齐由 [67] 完成,后者说明Hinode /SOT-SP数据中的一个指向错误 [13]. 同样,我们也把《性别歧视条例》/AIA数据与这个网格一致。 虽然Hinode / SOT-SP需要数十分钟才能获得扫描(导致内在的时间错配),但我们让方法处理潜在的不匹配,而不是在数据对齐中处理.
除了紫外线/欧洲紫外线滤波仪外,我们还提供先由每像素螺旋纬度构成的极性,以及作为辅助输入的太阳周期指标(奇数周期为1-1,偶数周期为−1-1),两者均来自SDO/AIA FITS头. 这提供了利用Hale定律进行极性推断所需的位置和时间背景。

blocks.en:
The Hinode /SOT-SP observations in our dataset are unfiltered, including active regions, plage, and quiet Sun.
We obtain 71,243 pairs of co-registered SDO /AIA intensity images and Hinode /SOT-SP vector magnetograms spanning from 2011 to 2024. Following [ 67 ] , data are split by acquisition time: the test set consists of years 2016 and 2024, with half-year buffers on both sides (2015 July - December, 2017 January - June and 2023 July - December) omitted to prevent data leakage from slowly evolving solar structures. The validation set consists of 2015 2015 January - June, 2017 2017 July - December and 2023 2023 January - June, and the remaining data form the training set. After filtering pairs with too small magnetograms to yield a 128 ​ ″ × 128 ​ ″ 128\arcsec\times 128\arcsec crop, the training, validation, and test sets consists of 29112 29112 , 6137 6137 , and 8307 8307 samples, respectively.

We also prepare fine-tuning datasets for generalization to STEREO /EUVI and GOES-R /SUVI. These EUV filtergrams are paired with SuperSynthIA [ 67 ] vector magnetograms (a ML-based method that produces Hinode /SOT-SP-like magnetograms from SDO /HMI data) reprojected to the corresponding instrument’s coordinate grid. A full description of the reprojection, calibration and normalization details appears in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们还编制精细的数据集,以便概括到STEREO/EUVI和GOES-R/SUVI。 这些EUV滤镜与SuperSynthIA[67]矢量磁学(一种基于ML的方法,从SDO/HMI数据中生成Hinode/SOT-SP类似磁学)成对,重新投射到相应的仪器坐标网格. 关于重新预测、校准和正常化细节的完整说明见附录C.4。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en:
We formulate the task of predicting solar vector magnetograms
from UV/EUV intensity observations as sampling a photospheric vector magnetogram conditioned on a stack of contemporaneous UV/EUV maps. Let 𝐈 ∈ ℝ H × W × C \mathbf{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C} denote  the conditioning information, consisting primarily of a stack of co-registered UV/EUV filtergrams, together with auxiliary inputs that provide physical context.
Let 𝐁 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} be the corresponding magnetogram components ( α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} ). Our goal is to learn a model that can sample 𝐁 n \mathbf{B}_{n} from p ⁡ ( 𝐁 ∣ 𝐈 n ) p(\mathbf{B}\mid\mathbf{I}_{n}) where 𝐈 n \mathbf{I}_{n} is unseen in training. This formulation allows us to sample multiple plausible magnetograms given the same UV/EUV input.

blocks.en: III.1 Diffusion Framework
blocks.zh: 三.1 传播框架

blocks.en:
We use denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs; [ 26 ] ) to learn to model p ⁡ ( 𝐁 ∣ 𝐈 ) p(\mathbf{B}\mid\mathbf{I}) .
These have shown efficacy in generating high fidelity images conditioned on other information, such as text.
A full introduction to DDPMs is beyond the scope of the paper, but the reader is directed to the introduction by [ 73 ] .
Briefly, DDPMs consist of two phases: a forward process that corrupts the image by adding Gaussian noise gradually over timesteps 1 , … , T 1,\ldots,T , and a reverse process where a parametric model ( f θ f_{\theta} , where θ \theta represents the model’s parameters) is tasked to remove noise.
By learning to remove this noise, the parametric model learns the given distribution. Figure 1 provides an overview of the diffusion process used by MAGiDiff .
For clarity, we use magnetogram-space notation in this high-level description of the DDPM framework. In the actual implementation of MAGiDiff , the diffusion process operates entirely in latent space, as introduced below and detailed in Appendix B .

blocks.en: In practice, we use several recent innovations to DDPM to improve training stability and efficiency. A full description of technical details appears in Appendix A . Here, we briefly summarize their key steps.
blocks.zh: 实际上,我们利用DDPM最近的一些创新来提高培训的稳定性和效率。 技术细节的完整说明见附录A。 在这里,我们简要总结一下它们的关键步骤。

blocks.en: Latent Diffusion Model. We adopt the latent diffusion model (LDM) structure [ 54 ] , where the forward and reverse processes are performed in a lower dimensional latent space, reducing spatial size while preserving image fidelity. The latent space is created by a variational autoencoder (VAE; [ 37 ] ) whose encoder and decoder translate between pixel and latent space representations.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-26). Latent Difusion Model. 我们采用潜在扩散模型结构[54],在低维潜在空间中进行前向和反向过程,缩小空间大小,同时保持图像的忠贞性。 潜在空间是由一个变异的自编码器(VAE;[37])创造的,其编码器和解码器在像素和潜在空间表示之间翻译.

blocks.en: V-objective. We use the v-objective [ 56 ] , where the model predicts a velocity term 𝐯 \mathbf{v} (a linear combination of noise ϵ \epsilon and clean magnetogram 𝐁 0 \mathbf{B}_{0} ) rather than predicting noise ϵ \epsilon or clean magnetogram 𝐁 0 \mathbf{B}_{0} alone. This formulation stabilizes training and yields higher sample quality.
blocks.zh: V -目标。 我们使用 v-目标 [56], 模型预测一个速度术语 v\ mathbf{v} (一个线性组合的噪音 \\\ epsilon 和干净的磁学 B 0\ mathbf{ B}_{0}) 而不是预测噪音 \\ epsilon 或干净的磁学 B 0\ mathbf{ B}_{0} 单独 。 这种配方稳定了培训,提高了样本质量。

blocks.en: Zero Terminal SNR. We enforce zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio following [ 45 ] , meaning that at timestep T T all structured signal are removed, leaving pure noise 𝐁 T = ϵ \mathbf{B}_{T}=\mbox{\boldmath$\epsilon$} . This allows MAGiDiff to estimate magnetograms with arbitrary mean intensity, capturing the full dynamic range of solar magnetic field strengths.
blocks.zh: 零终端 SNR. 我们在 [45] 之后执行零终端信号对噪声比,这意味着在时间步 T T 所有结构化的信号都被移除,留下纯噪音 B T = \ mathbf{B}_{T}=\mbox\boldmath$\epsilon$} 。 这使得MAGiDiff能够任意平均强度地估计磁学,捕捉太阳磁场强度的全部动态范围.

blocks.en: DDIM Sampling. During inference, we employ the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM; [ 62 ] ) sampler, which replaces the original stochastic, Markov inference process with a non-Markov, deterministic update path. This approach enables generating high-fidelity magnetogram predictions in fewer steps.
blocks.zh: DDIM采样. 在推论中,我们使用解析扩散隐含模型(DDIM;[62])采样器,它用非马尔科夫的定型更新路径取代了最初的斯图克,马尔科夫推论过程. 这种方法能够以更少的步法产生高纯度磁学预测.

blocks.en: III.2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 三.2 示范建筑

blocks.en: MAGiDiff consists of three components: a VAE that maps between pixel space and latent space, a spatial rescaler that projects conditioning UV/EUV maps to latent dimension, and a denoising U-Net that estimates latent representation of the clean vector magnetogram. These components are built with the HuggingFace Diffuser library. Figure 1 illustrates the denoising U-Net structure, while Figure 2 details the VAE and spatial rescaler architectures.
blocks.zh: MAGiDiff由三个部分组成:一个绘制像素空间和潜在空间之间的VAE,一个预测将紫外线/EUV映射到潜在维度的空间调整器,以及一个估计清洁矢量磁图潜在表现的去诺化的U-Net. 这些组件与HuggingFace Diffuser 库一起构建. 图1显示了去诺化的U-Net结构,而图2则详细介绍了VAE和空间调整器结构.

blocks.en: VAE. We adopt the AutoencoderKL from the HuggingFace Diffuser stable diffusion implementation. The encoder consists of two convolutional downsampling blocks followed by a self-attention downsampling block (DownEncoderBlock2D, DownEncoderBlock2D, AttnDownEncoderBlock2D), which progressively compress the input magnetograms into a compact latent representation. The decoder mirrors the structure to reconstruct latent back into pixel space. The latent representation is downsampled by a factor of 4 4 in height and width and is set to have six channels, balancing reconstruction quality with computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-07-26). VAE. 我们采用HuggingFace Diffuser稳定传播的自动编码器KL。 编码器由两个转录式下采样块组成,然后是自留心式下采样块(DownEncoderBlock2D,DownEncoderBlock2D,AttnDownEncoderBlock2D),它逐渐将输入式磁图压缩为紧凑的潜质表示. 解码器镜像结构,以重建潜伏回像素空间. 潜在表述以高度和宽度的4 4 个系数进行下取样,并设定有6个通道,兼顾重建质量和计算效率。

blocks.en: Spatial Rescaler for UV/EUV Filtergrams. The conditioning UV/EUV filtergrams are encoded by a multi-branch neural network designed for efficient spatial downsampling while preserving contextual information across scales. It consists of three parallel processing branches: (1) a multi-scale learnable feature extraction branch that captures feature at 1/4 and 1/8 resolution and then fused through cross-attention, (2) a learnable ConvNet branch, and (3) a traditional interpolation branch. All branches are ultimately concatenated and projected to the desired output dimension. This design enables the module to maintain fine details while capturing broader contextual information during downsampling. It also allows the spatial rescaler to learn on its own which features are important to extract, while still benefiting from context provided by traditional interpolation method.
blocks.zh: UV/EUV滤镜的空间调整器。 空调紫外线/EUV滤镜由多分支神经网络编码,设计为高效的空间下取样,同时保存跨尺度的上下文信息. 它由三个平行的处理分支组成:(1)一个多尺度的可学习特征提取分支,以1/4和1/8分辨率捕捉特征,然后通过交叉注意而熔化,(2)一个可学习的ConvNet分支,以及(3)一个传统的内插分支. 所有分支最终都得到整合并投射到期望的产出层面. 这一设计使模块能够保持精细的细节,同时在下取样时获取更广泛的背景信息。 它还使空间调整器能够自己学习哪些特征是重要的提取,同时仍然受益于传统插值法提供的背景。

blocks.en: Denoising U-Net. The denoising backbone adopts UNet2DConditionModel, also from the stable diffusion implementation. The encoder of the denoising U-Net consists of two convolutional downsampling blocks followed by an self-attention downsampling block (DownBlock2D, DownBlock2D, AttnDownBlock2D), enabling the model to gradually reduce spatial dimensions while capturing global context through an attention mechanism. At the bottleneck, we use a UNetMidBlock2DCrossAttn module with no external conditioning. In this configuration, the cross-attention layers reduce to self-attention, allowing the model to capture long-range dependencies within the latent representation while keeping the architecture compatible with potential conditional information for future work. The decoder symmetrically upsamples and fuses features via skip connections. This architecture maintains a balance between local detail preservation and large-scale contextual modeling, which is essential for reconstructing complex magnetic field patterns.
blocks.zh: 德诺瓦宁U-Net. 脱口而出的主干网采用UNet2DCondition Model,也是从稳定的传播实施中取得的. 解诺的U-Net的编码器包括两个旋律下取样块,然后是自留心下取样块(DownBlock2D,DownBlock2D,AttnDownBlock2D),使模型在通过关注机制捕捉全球背景的同时,可以逐渐减少空间维度. 在瓶颈处,我们使用一个没有外部条件的UNetMidBlock2DCrossAttn模块. 在这个构型中,交叉意向层缩小为自觉,使模型能够捕捉潜在表示中的长期依赖性,同时保持架构与未来工作的潜在条件信息兼容. 解码器通过跳过连接进行对称的上标和引信功能. 这种架构在局部细节保存和大规模背景模型制作之间保持平衡,这对于重建复杂的磁场模式至关重要.

blocks.en: III.3 Data Normalization
blocks.zh: 三.3 数据正常化

blocks.en:
Machine learning systems generally prefer data to be well normalized for stable and efficient training.
Gradient-based optimizers can struggle when feature values vary by orders of magnitude, which can lead to vanishing and exploding gradients.
This is exactly the case for both the UV/EUV intensity maps and the vector magnetograms.
blocks.zh:
机器学习系统一般倾向于使数据正常化,以便进行稳定和有效的培训。
基于渐变的优化器在特征值因数量级而异时会挣扎,这会导致梯度消失和爆炸.
紫外/EUV强度图和矢量磁力图都是这种情况。

blocks.en:
For SDO /AIA UV/EUV intensity data, quiet-Sun pixels are typically tens to hundreds counts per second ( DN s − 1 \text{\,}\mathrm{DN}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} ), whereas active region pixels can reach several thousand DN s − 1 \text{\,}\mathrm{DN}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} .
To make this long-tail distribution more suitable for training, we apply a log1p transform, defined as log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) , and then standardize each SDO /AIA channel using its per-channel mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh:
对于 SDO /AIA UV/EUV 强度数据,静态-太阳像素一般是每秒数以十到数百计(DN s − 1\ text ~, }\ mathrm{ DN}\ text ~, }{\ }{\ }{\ 1),而活跃的区域像素则可以达到几千 DN s − 1\ text ~,}\ mathrm{ dN}\ text →, }{\ }{\ 1}.
为了使这种长尾分布更适合训练,我们采用了log1p变换,定义为log ⁡ (1+x)\log(1+x),然后使用每个频道的平均值和标准偏差,将每个SDO/AIA信道标准化.

blocks.en: Apart from the UV/EUV filtergrams, the conditioning input includes auxiliary channels that are encoded separately. The disk mask is kept binary. The heliographic latitude map is expressed in degrees, divided by 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} to map on-disk values to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] ; off-disk pixels are assigned a value of − 2 -2 . The solar cycle indicator is encoded as 1 1 for odd-numbered cycles and − 1 -1 for even-numbered cycles. We therefore do not apply additional normalization to these auxiliary channels.
blocks.zh: 除了UV/EUV滤镜外,调制输入还包括单独编码的辅助通道. 磁盘面具是二进制的 。 平面纬度图以度表示,除以90 ∘ 90^{\circ}将盘上值映射到[− 1, 1];离盘像素被分配到− 2−2的值. 太阳周期指标编码为奇数周期的11个,偶数周期的−1-1个。 因此,我们没有对这些辅助渠道实行更多的正常化。

blocks.en:
Although less pronounced than the SDO /AIA intensity maps, vector magnetograms are also by nature long-tailed: most pixel values are close to zero, while active-region fields can reach several thousand Mx cm -2 .
For each vector magnetic field component, we divide the absolute field strength by 4000 4000 Mx cm -2 , take the square root, and restore the original sign. Thus, a 4000 4000 Mx cm -2 component has unit magnitude after normalization.
blocks.zh:
虽然比SDO /AIA强度图不明显,但矢量磁力图在性质上也长尾:大多数像素值接近0,而活动区域域可以达到几千 Mx cm -2.
对于每个矢量磁场元件,我们将绝对场强度除以4000 4000 Mx cm -2,取正方根,并恢复原来的标志. 因此,4000 4000 Mx cm -2 组件在正常化后具有单位规模。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: We now describe the evaluation of MAGiDiff on unseen data from five complementary perspectives. First, we assess MAGiDiff on a per-pixel basis, treating it purely as a method that takes a set of UV/EUV filtergrams and produces a vector field. Next, we examine whether MAGiDiff recovers the correct magnetic polarity. Having analyzed MAGiDiff , we then turn to comparing it to a more standard regression approach to test its contribution. We further analyze the distribution learned by MAGiDiff . Finally, we evaluate MAGiDiff ’s generalization ability beyond the training setting, including full-disk observations and data from other instruments.
blocks.zh: 我们现在从五个互补的角度来描述MAGiDiff对无形数据的评价。 首先,我们按每像素对MAGiDiff进行评估,将它完全当作一种方法,它取用一组紫外/EUV滤镜并产生一个矢量场. 接下来,我们研究MAGiDiff是否恢复了正确的磁极性. 在分析了MAGiDiff之后,我们转而把它比作一种更标准的回归法来检验它的贡献。 我们进一步分析MagiDiff的分布。 最后,我们评价MAGiDiff在培训环境之外的一般化能力,包括全磁盘观测和其他仪器的数据。

blocks.en: We next examine the joint distributions of the pixel values predicted by MAGiDiff and the corresponding values in Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms across the full test set, as shown in Figure 4 . UV/EUV filtergram intensities are sign-invariant, and therefore are not sufficient for determining polarity. Hale’s law [ 19 ] nevertheless could be used to resolve this ambiguity: for bipolar active regions, the expected leading polarity depends on the hemisphere and reverses between successive solar cycles. Thus, UV/EUV filtergrams, heliographic latitude, and solar cycle information may together allow the MAGiDiff to infer the correct polarity.
Because the SDO /AIA filtergrams are physically corrected for instrumental degradation, solar cycle parity should not, in principle, be inferable from the filtergrams alone. This reasoning motivates us to provide MAGiDiff with an explicit polarity prior , consisting of a per-pixel heliographic latitude map and a binary solar cycle indicator.

blocks.en: To understand how MAGiDiff resolves polarity ambiguity, we evaluate three training formulations. • ( MAGiDiff ± 𝐁 \pm\mathbf{B} ) trains MAGiDiff to produce both 𝐁 \mathbf{B} and − 𝐁 -\mathbf{B} as equally valid training targets, since both orientations yield the same UV/EUV intensities. Because the training objective has no preference for either orientation, the model should randomly select between the two. • ( MAGiDiff No Polarity Prior ) uses the real Hinode /SOT-SP magnetogram as the target, without introducing any 𝐁 \mathbf{B} vs − 𝐁 -\mathbf{B} ambiguity into the training objective. Theoretically, UV/EUV inputs contain no direct information that is correlated with photospheric magnetic polarity, so the model should perform close to chance. • ( MAGiDiff ) is MAGiDiff as described in Section III , including the polarity prior. The polarity prior provides MAGiDiff with information that is needed in order to use Hale’s law to estimate the polarity.

blocks.en: We report results in Table 1 , comparing all three methods. We additionally provide a qualitative comparison on a representative sample in Figure 5 . As expected, MAGiDiff ± 𝐁 \pm\mathbf{B} produces near-chance performance. Similarly, since MAGiDiff has access to information about solar cycle and latitude that permits the use of Hale’s law, it is able to obtain the polarity quite accurately, at 92.7% accuracy. This demonstrates that the network can take advantage of this signal and assign polarities. However, surprisingly MAGiDiff No Polarity Prior performs far above chance, at 86.7%. This unexpectedly strong performance motivated us to investigate what provided the missing polarity information.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告结果,比较所有三种方法。 此外,我们还提供了图5中代表性样本的质量比较。 如预期,MAGiDiff ± B\pm\mathbf{B}产生近切性能. 同样,由于MAGiDiff能够获得关于太阳周期和纬度的信息,从而可以使用Hale定律,因此它能够非常准确地获得极性,精确度为92.7%。 这表明网络可以利用这个信号并分配极性. 然而,令人惊讶的是,MAGiDiff No Polarity Prior的性能远远高于机会,为86.7%。 这种出人意料的强烈表现促使我们调查提供了缺失的极性信息的内容。

blocks.en: Our suspicion was that the model was exploiting Hale’s law by implicitly obtaining the information needed to use the law to assign polarity, namely latitude and solar cycle number. We therefore conducted auxiliary experiments to determine if these could be determined from UV/EUV filtergrams. We trained basic ResNet-50 [ 23 ] models for northern-vs-southern hemisphere and solar cycle 24-vs-25, and evaluated following the split in Section II .
blocks.zh: 我们怀疑该模型是在利用Hale的定律,暗中获取利用定律确定极性所需的信息,即纬度和太阳周期号。 因此,我们进行了辅助实验,以确定是否可以从紫外线/欧盟紫外线滤波图中确定。 我们为北-南半球和太阳周期24-vs-25培训了基本的ResNet-50[23]模型,并在第二节分拆后进行了评估。

blocks.en: Northern-vs-southern Hemisphere was relatively easy for the classifier, with 94.7% accuracy and an AUROC of 0.998. Its performance degrades only near the equator, from 97.8 % 97.8\% for crops beyond ± 25 ∘ \pm 25^{\circ} in heliographic latitude to 73.7 % 73.7\% for crops within ± 10 ∘ \pm 10^{\circ} . These results indicate that the classifier exploits geometric cues such as foreshortening and center to limb intensity variations to infer hemisphere.

More surprisingly, the solar cycle classifier reaches 98.5 % 98.5\% accuracy and an AUROC of 0.996 0.996 . This result is unexpected because UV/EUV filtergrams do not encode time, and the SDO /AIA degradation correction is intended to remove long-term instrumental changes. Thus, the solar cycle should not be detectable in, for instance, the average intensity. However, since the instrument throughput has decreased , the signal to noise ratio has changed. As a simplified worked example, consider a light source that at mission start would produce a 100 100 DN s -1 count on the detector. Assuming a Poisson model, this measurement would have a standard deviation of 10 10 DN s -1 . After a 5 × 5\times degradation in filter performance over the mission, the same light would yield 20 20 DN s -1 with a standard deviation of 20 \sqrt{20} . The standard degradation correction increases the signal 5 × 5\times , recovering the original 100 100 DN s -1 , but with a final noise strength of 5 ​ 20 = 22.4 5\sqrt{20}=22.4 DN s -1 . The change in noise strength would leave a signature in the images, which would be visible in differences across the pixels, especially in channels with strong degradation and low count rates.
blocks.zh: 更令人惊讶的是,太阳周期分类器的精确度达到98.5%,AUROC为0.996 0.996。 这个结果出乎意料,因为紫外线/EUV滤波器没有编码时间,而SDO/AIA降解校正是为了去除长期的器件变化. 因此,太阳循环不应以平均强度等来探测。 然而,由于仪器吞吐量下降,信号与噪声的比例发生了变化. 作为一个简化的例子,考虑一个光源,在飞行任务开始时,该光源将产生100个100个DNs-1的探测器。 假设Poisson模型,这种测量的标准偏差为10 10 DNs-1。 在任务中过滤性能发生5×5\的降解后,同一光线将产生20个20 DNs-1,标准偏差为20\sqrt{20}. 标准降解修正会增加信号 5× 5\ 时, 恢复原始 100 100 DN s - 1, 但最终噪音强度为 5 20 = 22.4 5\ sqrt{ 20× 22.4 DN 第1条。 噪音强度的变化会在图像中留下一个签名,这在像素之间的差异中可以明显看出,特别是在强烈退化和计数率低的渠道中.

blocks.en: Channel ablations provide evidence that the network may be doing this. We retested the network while replacing each channel with its dataset mean in order to test dependence. 304Å has a relatively low count rate and has had a nearly 10 × 10\times drop in measured strength over the mission. Performance in classifying the solar cycle drops precipitously to an accuracy of 50% when 304Å is replaced. On the other hand, 1700Å has remained steady and replacing 1700Å with the dataset mean has virtually no effect on performance.
blocks.zh: 频道故障提供了网络可能这样做的证据。 我们重新测试了网络,同时将每个频道更换为它的数据集,以测试依赖性。 304Å的计数率相对较低,比任务时的测得强度下降近10×10\. 304 取代时,太阳周期的分类性能急剧下降至50%。 另一方面,1700Å保持稳定,用数据集平均值取代1700Å对业绩几乎没有影响。

blocks.en:
Together, these suggest that there are real signals that can be exploited in the passbands after correction, allowing neural networks to infer solar cycle polarity.
However, inferring these information indirectly from UV/EUV filtergrams, particularly solar cycle parity from instrument-specific degradation, is less robust than providing it as input directly. We therefore supply MAGiDiff with per-pixel heliographic latitude map and a binary solar cycle indicator as polarity prior . And indeed adding this explicit prior further increases overall polarity accuracy.
blocks.zh:
这些因素加在一起表明,有一些真正的信号在修正后可以在通过带中加以利用,使得神经网络可以推断太阳循环极性.
然而,间接地从紫外/欧盟紫外线滤镜中推断出这些信息,特别是从仪器特定降解中推断出太阳周期的等值,其强度不如直接作为投入提供。 因此,我们向MAGiDiff提供每像素的太阳纬度图和二进制太阳周期指标,作为前极性。 并且确实添加了之前的这个明确内容,进一步提高了整体的极性准确性.

blocks.en: IV.3.2 Classification by AR type
blocks.zh: 四.3.2 按AR类型分类

blocks.en: To identify the magnetic configurations in which MAGiDiff reliably recovers polarity and those in which it fails, we divide the test samples according to Mount Wilson active region class [ 18 , 28 ] following the method described in [ 40 ] . Each sample is assigned the class of the most complex NOAA active region [ 28 ] within its valid ground truth footprint. We further validate candidate associations against the observations using sunspot darkness in SDO /HMI continuum map, plage brightness in co-aligned SDO /AIA 1600Å filtergram, and magnetogram structure in the ground truth Hinode /SOT-SP vector magnetogram. Samples with no corresponding active region are grouped as quiet sun (QS) or plage. We also exclude near-limb samples for which at least half of the valid pixels have μ < 0.35 \mu<0.35 , where μ \mu is the cosine of the viewing angle. These samples are strongly affected by foreshortening and yield less reliable measurement.
blocks.zh: 为了确定MAGiDiff可靠地恢复极性时的磁性构型和那些它失效时的磁性构型,我们按照威尔逊山活动区级[18,28]按照[40]中描述的方法来划分测试样本. 每个样本被分配到其有效地面真实足迹中最复杂的NOAA活动区域的类别[28]. 我们进一步验证候选协会在SDO/HMI连续图中利用太阳点暗观测结果、在SDO/AIA 1600X滤波图中利用插孔亮度以及地面真能Hinode/SOT-SP矢量磁图中的磁图结构。 没有相应活动区域的样本被归类为静阳(QS)或plage. 我们还排除了至少半数有效像素有μ < 0.35\mu < 0.35,其中μ\mu是取景角度的余弦的近闪石样本. 这些样品因预估时间短和产量不可靠而受到严重影响。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports the wrong polarity rate for each class, defined as the fraction of samples with τ ≥ 1 \tau\geq 1 . As expected, MAGiDiff ± 𝐁 \pm\mathbf{B} performs near chance and MAGiDiff with polarity prior does the best in all cases. We therefore focus on how performance varies across active region classes.

blocks.en: IV.4 Comparison with Regression Baseline
blocks.zh: 四.4 与回归基线的比较

blocks.en: We next ask whether this reconstruction requires a stochastic generative model or can instead be achieved with a standard deterministic approach. Because the input filtergrams and target vector magnetograms are spatially aligned, a natural starting point is to formulate the task as image-to-image regression. To this end, we train a regression U-Net using exactly the same training data as MAGiDiff with an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} objective and compare its predictions with those of MAGiDiff . The regression U-Net produces a single deterministic magnetogram for each input, whereas MAGiDiff can generate multiple stochastic realizations by sampling from the learned conditional distribution. This distinction is particularly relevant because magnetic structure is only indirectly encoded in the UV/EUV filtergrams, leaving local magnetic field weakly constrained, particularly in weak-field regions. Multiple fine-scale magnetic structure configurations may therefore be consistent with the same input. Under an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} objective, the regression model tends to predict the average across these possibilities and therefore loses fine-scale detail. Comparing the two approaches therefore allows us to assess how modeling a conditional distribution, rather than producing a single regression estimate, affects reconstruction accuracy and structural realism.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要问,这种重建需要一种有条理的基因模型,还是可以用标准的确定方法来实现。 由于输入滤镜和目标矢量磁图在空间上对齐,一个自然的起点是将任务定型为图像到图像回归. 为此,我们使用与MAGiDiff完全相同的训练数据进行回归U-Net的训练,目标为l 2\ell_{2}并将其预测与MAGiDiff的预测进行比较。 回归U-Net为每个输入产生一个单一的定量磁力图,而MAGiDiff则可以通过从学到的有条件分布中采样来产生多个分层实现. 这种区分特别相关,因为磁性结构只在紫外/EUV滤镜中间接编码,使局部磁场受到微弱的制约,特别是在弱场区域. 因此,多个细尺度磁结构配置可能与相同的输入一致. 在一个l 2\ell\\2}目标下,回归模型倾向于预测这些可能性的平均值,因此失去了细度的细节. 因此,对这两种方法进行比较,使我们能够评估有条件分配的模式,而不是产生单一回归估计,如何影响重建的准确性和结构现实性。

blocks.en: IV.4.1 Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 四.4.1 定性比较

blocks.en: We begin with qualitative inspection in Figure 7 , where we show MAGiDiff and the regression U-Net baseline side by side. MAGiDiff produces sharper structures, finer details, and quiet-Sun regions that more closely resemble the Hinode /SOT-SP vector magnetograms. The regression baseline recovers the dominant active structure, but tends to produce smoother and more spatially averaged fields where compact features are weakened, sharp boundaries are softened, and weak-field regions appear overly quiet compared with the Hinode /SOT-SP observations.

Both models reproduce the large-scale power measured by Hinode /SOT-SP, but the baseline increasingly loses power at finer spatial scale, whereas MAGiDiff remains closer to the Hinode /SOT-SP spectrum.

These metrics only report pixel-to-pixel accuracy, and so to provide a more holistic picture, we report four additional metrics that capture distributional and structural fidelity. 3. 1-Wasserstein distance ( W 1 W_{1} ) . Also known as the Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD; [ 55 ] ) in computer vision, W 1 W_{1} [ 35 ] measures the minimum transformation cost of transporting probability mass between two distributions. For each field component, we construct empirical one-dimensional distributions from valid pixel values in the prediction and ground truth, and compute the transport cost required to transform one distribution into the other. Thus, W 1 W_{1} measures agreement between the predicted and ground truth distributions without considering the spatial locations of individual pixels, where lower values indicate better agreement. 4. ∇ 
abla -ratio . Spatial gradients characterize the strength and location of local magnetic field variations. Preserving these quantities is important not only for reproducing magnetic structures, but also for downstream calculations of physical quantities based on field derivatives, for example electric current density. ∇ 
abla -ratio is the ratio of the total gradient magnitude in the prediction to that in the ground truth. It is measured by aggregating gradient magnitude over the entire image, providing a global measure of whether the model preserves the overall level of spatial variation. Values near unity indicate matched overall sharpness, whereas values below unity indicate over-smoothing, and values above unity indicate excessive spatial variation, which may result from overly sharp structures or noise. 5. ∇ 
abla -MAE . Because ∇ 
abla -ratio compares only the aggregated gradient magnitudes, predictions can have similar values even when the variations occur at incorrect locations. We therefore also report ∇ 
abla -MAE, the mean absolute error on per-pixel gradient magnitudes. This metric complements the global ∇ 
abla -ratio by penalizing discrepancies in the locations and strengths of local spatial variations. 6. Radially averaged logarithmic spectral distance (RALSD) . RALSD [ 20 ] compares the predicted and ground truth power spectra, with lower values indicating better agreement. To compute this, we first apply a two-dimensional Fourier transform to each sample and calculate the power spectrum as the squared magnitude of the Fourier coefficients. We then azimuthally average the power over concentric rings in frequency space, producing a one-dimensional radial power spectrum indexed by spatial frequency magnitude. RALSD is then computed as the root mean square error, across radial frequency bins, between the predicted and ground truth power spectra after conversion to decibels. For comparability across samples, we compute RALSD on a 128 ​ ″ × 128 ​ ″ 128\arcsec	imes 128\arcsec cutout centered within the largest fully valid region of each test sample. RALSD therefore measures whether the prediction distributes the correct amount of power across spatial scales, from large-scale magnetic structure to fine-scale details.

blocks.en:
Beyond evaluating individual predictions, we examine whether the predictive distribution learned by MAGiDiff respects physical relationships among magnetic structures.
In particular, a useful distribution should encode relationships among pixels: pixels belonging to the same magnetic structure should tend to share the same polarity across realizations, pixels rooted at opposite ends of a closed magnetic loop should exhibit opposite polarity, while unrelated quiet-Sun pixels should show little polarity correlation. The probabilistic formulation of MAGiDiff allows us to probe these relationships directly by sampling ensembles of realizations.

除了评估个别的预测外,我们还要研究MAGiDiff所学到的预测分布是否尊重磁结构之间的物理关系.

blocks.en: We show correlation maps of representative samples in Figure 8 . These examples show that MAGiDiff captures structured nonlocal relationships in the sampled distribution, including intra-plage coherence and correlations that are largely consistent with magnetic connectivity.

blocks.en: This correlation structure may be useful even when the full magnetogram prediction is not used directly. For instance, given the polarity of a small set of pixels in an image from surface flux transport models [ 68 , 66 , 6 ] , the learned correlations could help propagate polarity information to remaining pixels.
blocks.zh: 即使没有直接使用完整的磁图预测,这种关联结构也可能有用. 例如,鉴于从表面通量迁移模型[68、66、6]的图像中一小组像素的极性,所学到的关联性可有助于将极性信息传播给剩余的像素。

blocks.en: This ability to generate a distribution also enables estimation of uncertainty quantification (e.g., the per-pixel standard deviation), which is important for applications. Similar to the correlation map analysis, the generative nature of diffusion models allows us to draw a large ensemble of realizations and probe the per-pixel uncertainty. Before uncertainty computation, we downsample all realizations to a coarser grid. This reduces sensitivity to co-registration error, limited optical resolution, and temporal mismatch (since the UV/EUV input is near-instantaneous snapshot while the corresponding magnetogram is captured over a one-hour interval). The uncertainty is then quantified as the per-pixel standard deviation normalized by its mean magnitude, computed over the set of downsampled realizations. As an example, Figure 9 shows uncertainty map for the four samples in Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 这种生成分布的能力也能够估算不确定性量化(如每像素标准偏差),这对应用很重要. 与相关映射分析类似,扩散模型的遗传性质使我们能够绘制一个大型的实现组合,并探测每像素的不确定性. 在计算不确定性之前,我们把所有的实现都降低到一个较宽的网格。 这降低了对共登记误差,光学分辨率有限,以及时间不匹配的敏感性(因为紫外线/EUV输入是近瞬间快照,而相应的磁图是在一个小时的间隔内捕获的). 然后将不确定性量化为每像素标准偏差按其平均值正常化,并按一组下图的实现计算。 例如,图9显示了图8中四个样本的不确定性图。

blocks.en: Our correlation map and uncertainty analysis show that models like MAGiDiff can not only predict magnetograms, but also learn the structure of the full output distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们的关联图和不确定性分析显示,像MAGiDiff这样的模型不仅可以预测磁图,还可以学习全输出分布的结构.

blocks.en: IV.6 Cross Solar Cycle Generalization
blocks.zh: 四.6 跨太阳循环的普及

blocks.en:
We next ask whether MAGiDiff can generalize across the polarity reversal between solar cycles. This is a challenging test because, according to Hale’s law, the leading polarity
in the northern and southern heliographic hemispheres reverses between solar cycles. It is therefore important to test whether MAGiDiff , when trained only on data from one solar cycle, can generalize to other solar cycles.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来问,MAGiDiff是否能够将太阳周期之间的极性逆转泛指。 这是一个具有挑战性的考验,因为根据Hale的法律,领先的极性
在北纬和南纬的太阳系中,太阳周期之间发生逆转。 因此,必须检验MAGiDiff(只接受一个太阳周期的数据培训)是否能够通向其他太阳周期。

blocks.en: To test this, we train a separate model using only observations from solar cycle 24 24 and evaluate it only on solar cycle 25 25 data . During training, we use a simple polarity-flip augmentation to expose the model to both solar cycle labels while using only solar cycle 24 observations. With probability 0.5 0.5 , the dataset flips the sign of all three target vector magnetogram components and changes the solar cycle indicator to the solar cycle 25 25 value, while leaving the UV/EUV inputs and latitude channel unchanged. This augmentation provides examples that mimic solar cycle 25 25 and helps address the cross cycle generalization difficulty. Apart from this augmentation, training follows the standard MAGiDiff procedure.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这一点,我们培训一个单独的模型,只利用来自太阳24周期的观测结果,并且只在太阳25周期的数据上加以评价。 在训练期间,我们使用简单的极性-裂变增强法将模型暴露在两个太阳循环标签上,而只使用太阳循环24的观测. 以概率0.5 0.5,数据集翻转所有三个目标矢量磁学元件的标志,并将太阳周期指标改为太阳周期25 25 值,同时使紫外线/EUV输入和纬度通道不变. 这种增强提供了模仿太阳25 25周期的范例,并有助于解决跨周期通化困难。 除了这种增强外,培训还遵循MAGiDiff标准程序。

blocks.en: At test time, solar cycle 25 25 samples spanning 2020 to 2024 are passed into the model with their true solar cycle indicator. Using the polarity score defined in Equation 5 , the model recovers the correct polarity for 89.7 % 89.7\% among 16,201 16,201 samples with threshold τ < 1 \tau<1 . With a stricter threshold τ < 0.5 \tau<0.5 , we get a passing rate of 83.3 % 83.3\% . Beyond polarity agreement, qualitative inspection shows performance consistent with the original MAGiDiff model. These results indicate that MAGiDiff can generalize across solar cycles.
blocks.zh: 在测试时,从2020年到2024年的25个太阳周期样本随其真实太阳周期指标传入模型。 使用方程式5定义的极性分数,该模型在16,201个16,201个标本中回收89.7%的89.7%的正确极性,其阈值 < 1\tau < 1。 使用更严格的阈值 < 0.5\tau < 0.5, 我们的通过率为83.3% 83.3% 。 除了极性协议外,质检显示的性能与原MAGiDiff模型一致. 这些结果表明,MAGiDiff可以概括整个太阳周期。

blocks.en: We now evaluate whether MAGiDiff can be applied to full-disk UV/EUV observations. This setting is well beyond the model’s training distribution: MAGiDiff is trained on co-registered 128 ​ ″ × 128 ​ ″ 128\arcsec\times 128\arcsec cutouts, whereas full-disk inference requires the model to handle much larger spatial context, extended plage regions, and the off-disk area. Therefore, some aspects of full-disk prediction of magnetograms are expected to not work — e.g., large-scale plage patches spanning larger regions. Nevertheless, it is unclear whether the method would generalize even to active regions. Indeed, in early development, we found that MAGiDiff without a binary disk mask produced spurious magnetogram hallucinations near disk center when applied directly to full-disk inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们现在评估是否可将MAGiDiff应用于全磁盘紫外线/欧盟紫外线观测。 这种环境远远超出了模式的培训范围: MAGiDiff接受关于共同注册128 ×× 128 × 128\arcsec\times 128\arcsec剪切的培训,而全磁盘推论则要求模型处理更大的空间环境,扩展的插板区域,以及离磁盘区域. 因此,对磁学进行全磁盘预测的一些方面预期行不通——例如,跨越较大区域的大规模插板补丁。 然而,目前还不清楚这一方法是否会普遍适用于活跃区域。 事实上,在早期的开发中,我们发现没有二进制磁盘掩码的MAGiDiff在磁盘中心附近直接应用到全磁盘输入时会产生假磁图幻觉.

blocks.en:
In addition to the binary disk mask, we find that two modifications are critical for producing spatially coherent full-disk predictions.
First, motivated by resolution-dependent noise scheduling [ 27 , 11 ] , we adjust the noise schedule used to train MAGiDiff . As image resolution increases, a large-scale structure spans more pixels and thus the same per-pixel noise level has a weaker effect on the structure since the independent pixel noise averages out over the large number of pixels of the structure. Consequently, a noise schedule tuned on 128 ​ ″ × 128 ​ ″ 128\arcsec\times 128\arcsec crops is too weak on full-disk images. We therefore retrain MAGiDiff from scratch with the log signal-to-noise ratio lowered by 3.65 3.65 nats at every diffusion timestep. This shift corresponds to a roughly 6 6 times larger canvas, making the denoising difficulty more comparable between training and inference time.
Second, we adopt a tiled inference procedure motivated by MultiDiffusion [ 1 ] . As in standard diffusion inference, the process begins with a full-disk canvas of random noise and progressively denoises it into a clean magnetogram. The difference is that, at each denoising step, the canvas is divided into overlapping 256 ​ ″ × 256 ​ ″ 256\arcsec\times 256\arcsec windows, and MAGiDiff predicts a denoising update for each window using the corresponding UV/EUV observation crop. These updates are averaged in overlapping regions and combined to form a full-disk estimate used in the next denoising step. This procedure allows MAGiDiff to operate at a spatial scale close to what it is trained on while producing a spatially coherent full-disk prediction.
blocks.zh:
除了二进制磁盘遮罩外,我们发现两个修改对于产生空间连贯的全磁盘预测至关重要.
首先,基于依赖分辨率的噪音排程[27,11],我们调整用于训练MAGiDiff的噪音排程. 随着图像分辨率的增加,一个大尺度结构的跨度更大像素,因此,自独立像素噪声在结构的大量像素上平均排出后,同样的每像素噪声水平对结构的影响更弱. 因此,128 ×× 128 × 128\ arcsec\times 128\ arcsec 作物在全碟图像上太弱。 因此,我们从零开始对MAGiDiff进行再培训,每个扩散时间点的日志信号与噪声比降低3.65 3.65纳特。 这一变化相当于大约6倍大的画布,使得在培训与推断时间之间更能比较的去名难。
第二,我们采用由多重扩散推动的推论程序。 与标准扩散推论一样,这个过程从随机噪声的全盘布开始,并逐渐将其暴露为干净的磁图. 不同之处在于,在每一个调试步骤中,画布被分为重叠的256×××256××256\arcsec\times 256\arcsec窗口,MAGiDiff利用相应的紫外线/EUV观测作物预测每个窗口的调试更新. 这些更新按重叠区域平均进行,合并后形成下一个解密步骤所用的全盘估计。 这一程序允许MAGiDiff在空间范围上运行,与它所接受的训练相近,同时产生空间一致的全磁盘预测.

blocks.en: As a demonstration of this approach, we show MAGiDiff prediction on a full-disk map from 2016 February 5, 07:12 TAI, which lands in the test set time range. We compare against two references. The first is the standard SDO /HMI vector magnetogram product. The second is SuperSynthIA [ 67 ] , which uses SDO /HMI Stokes profiles to produce disambiguated magnetograms that resemble Hinode /SOT-SP. SuperSynthIA and SDO /HMI agree in many places, but have some differences in quiet regions and plage characteristics.
blocks.zh: 作为这个方法的示范,我们在2016年2月5日07:12TAI的全盘地图上显示MAGiDiff的预测,TAI在测试设定的时间范围内着陆. 我们比较了两个参考文献。 第一个是标准SDO/HMI矢量磁学产品. 第二个是SuperSynthIA [67],它使用SDO/HMI Stokes剖面图来产生与Hinode /SOT-SP相似的离散磁图. SuperSynthIA和SDO/HMI在很多地方都同意,但在安静的地区和plage特性上有一些差异.

blocks.en:
We show results in Figure 10 . MAGiDiff recovers active-region magnetic structure that broadly resembles both SDO /HMI and SuperSynthIA.
The hexbin plots in Figure 18 provide a quantitative comparison with the SuperSynthIA reference: the dominant pixel densities concentrate near the 1 : 1 1{:}1 relation across all field components. Although the slopes of fitted lines are below unity and might suggest systematic field strength underestimation, closer inspection shows that this disagreement is not uniform across all field strengths. Strong field pixels generally remain close to the 1 : 1 1{:}1 relation, whereas the dominating weak and intermediate field pixels are more significantly underestimated. These pixels mainly correspond to plage and weak fields, which are more difficult to recover as their magnetic signals are weaker, more spatially diffused, and less constrained by the UV/EUV observations.
blocks.zh:
图10显示结果。 MAGiDiff回收了活动区域磁性结构,这种磁性结构与SDO/HMI和SuperSynthIa大致相似。
图18中的hexbin地块提供了与SuperSynthIA参考文献的定量比较: 主要的像素密度集中在1:1{}1 关系在所有域组件上. 虽然装配线路的坡度低于统一度,可能表明系统性的实地力量低估,但更仔细的检查表明,这种分歧并非在所有实地力量中都是统一的。 强字段像素一般保持接近1 :1{{}1关系,而占支配地位的弱字段和中间字段像素则被更显著的低估. 这些像素主要对应插座和弱场,由于它们的磁信号较弱,空间分布较广,受UV/EUV观测的制约较少,因此回收难度更大.

blocks.en:
The remaining failure occurs primarily in large plage regions, where MAGiDiff may assign the wrong polarity to part of a bipolar structure and may produce overly coherent unipolar structure. Although the location and morphology of the plage are preserved, its polarity can be incorrect.
We hypothesize that this stems from the training setup: at the 128 ​ ″ × 128 ​ ″ 128\arcsec\times 128\arcsec scale, plage regions often appear as locally unipolar patches, so the model has limited context for resolving large-scale plage polarity.
blocks.zh:
其余的故障主要发生在大插座地区,MAGiDiff可能将错误的极性分配给两极结构的一部分,并可能产生过于连贯的单极结构. 虽然pl的方位和形态得到保存,但其极性可能不正确.
我们假设这源于训练设置:在128 × 128 × 128\ arcsec\times 128\ arcsec的尺度上,plage区域经常作为局部的单极补丁出现,因此该模型解决大规模plage极性的背景有限.

blocks.en: Overall, these results suggest that MAGiDiff can generalize beyond Hinode /SOT-SP-sized cutouts, but also highlight the need for additional global context when resolving large-scale structure. In practical applications, this limitation could be mitigated in several ways. One approach is to take polarity from other signals for plage (e.g., in a far-side estimation task, using data from a surface flux transport model). Another approach is to use a hierarchical model that produces global polarity information (e.g., a variant of MAGiDiff trained to map from SDO /AIA to SDO /HMI).
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,MAGiDiff可以概括到Hinode / SOT-SP规模的断层之外,但也突出了在解决大规模结构时需要额外的全球背景. 在实际应用中,这种限制可以几种方式减轻。 一种方法是从其他信号中取极性作为插件(例如,在远边估计任务中,利用地表通量迁移模型的数据)。 另一种方法是使用一个产生全球极性信息的分级模型(例如,MAGiDiff的一个变体,经过培训,可以将SDO/AIA映射到SDO/HMI).

blocks.en: IV.8 Migration to STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI Data
blocks.zh: 四.8 向STEREO/EUVI和GOES/SUVI数据的迁移

blocks.en:

Top to bottom: MAGiDiff predictions from 3 3 channel full-disk STEREO /EUVI EUV filtergrams, cropped post-inference to regions A and B (row 1), and inferred directly on the EUV cutouts of the same regions (row 2); same for 5 5 channel GOES–16 /SUVI EUV filtergrams (rows 3 – 4) and 5 5 channel GOES–18 /SUVI EUV filtergrams (rows 5 – 6); SuperSynthIA reference (row 7).

blocks.en: A primary motivation for MAGiDiff is expanding the scope of data that can be obtained by using instruments that lack a spectropolarimeter. We thus test whether MAGiDiff can be adapted to two such instruments: the Extreme Ultraviolet Imager onboard STEREO ( STEREO /EUVI) and the Solar UltraViolet Imager onboard GOES-R ( GOES /SUVI). Both deliver multi-wavelength EUV imagery, but neither has the full SDO /AIA channel set, and both differ from SDO /AIA in photometric calibration, spatial resolution, and point-spread function. In addition, STEREO /EUVI observes the Sun from a substantially different vantage point.
blocks.zh: MAGiDiff的主要动机是扩大数据范围,这些数据可以通过使用缺乏分光极度计的仪器获得。 因此,我们检验MAGiDiff是否可以适应两个这样的仪器:STEREO(STEREO/EUVI)上的极端紫外线成像仪和GOES-R(GOES/SUVI)上的太阳紫外线成像仪。 两者都提供多波长的EUV影像,但都没有完整的SDO/AIA通道设置,两者在光度校准,空间分辨率,和点广函数上都与SDO/AIA不同. 此外,STEREO/EUVI从完全不同的有利角度观测太阳。

blocks.en:
This setting is more challenging than the SDO /AIA-to- Hinode /SOT-SP task for two main reasons.
First, the available EUV passbands primarily originate in the chromosphere, transition region, and corona rather than the photosphere, thus provide only indirect constraints on the photospheric magnetic field.
Second, neither STEREO nor GOES provides vector magnetogram measurements, and Hinode /SOT-SP does not provide sufficiently dense co-observations to construct paired training sets.
Because true STEREO /EUVI far-side predictions cannot be directly validated without simultaneous far-side vector magnetograms, we evaluate the model in a proxy setting in which magnetic supervision is available: we use periods when each EUV instrument has substantial field-of-view overlap with SDO /HMI, generate SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms from the corresponding SDO /HMI Stokes observations, and reproject these magnetograms onto the coordinate grid of the respective instrument.
These reprojected SuperSynthIA magnetograms are used as the fine-tuning target and the validation reference.
This proxy experiment provides a way to validate whether MAGiDiff can generalize to other EUV instruments and recover vector magnetograms from their EUV observations.
blocks.zh:
这种设置比SDO/AIA-to-Hinode/SOT-SP任务更具挑战性,主要原因有二.
首先,现有的EUV传波段主要源于色圈,过渡区,以及日冕而不是光圈,因此只能对光圈磁场提供间接限制.
第二,STEREO和GOES都没有提供矢量磁学测量,Hinode /SOT-SP没有提供足够密集的共观测以建造配对的训练装置.
由于真实的STEREO/EUVI远侧预测如果没有同时的远侧矢量磁力图,就无法直接验证,所以我们用可提供磁导的代理设置来评价该模型:我们使用每个EUV仪器与SDO/HMI有大量视场重叠的时段,从相应的SDO/HMI Stokes观测中生成SuperSynthIA矢量磁力图,并将这些磁力图重新投射到相应仪器的坐标网格上.
这些重新投影的SuperSynthIa磁图被用作微调目标和验证参考.
这个代理实验提供了验证MAGiDiff是否能够概括到其他EUV仪器,并从他们的EUV观测中回收矢量磁图的方法.

blocks.en:
We adapt MAGiDiff to each instrument using a two-stage fine-tuning procedure. First, we fine-tune the VAE on SuperSynthIA magnetograms so that the latent space better matches the target magnetogram distribution. Second, we fine-tune two separate denoising U-Nets for STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI on their corresponding instrument-specific dataset while keeping the VAE frozen.
The base model that is fine-tuned upon is trained with the resolution-adjusted noise schedule described in Section IV.7 . The resulting full-disk prediction generation also follows the tiled inference procedure.
The detailed fine-tuning procedure is provided in Section C.4 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用两阶段的微调程序使MAGiDiff适应每个仪器. 首先,我们微调了超合成磁图上的VAE,这样潜伏空间就能更好地匹配目标磁图分布. 第二,我们对STEREO/EUVI和GOES/SUVI两个单独的U-Net进行微调,说明它们相应的仪器专用数据集,同时保持VAE的冻结.
对经过微调的基础模型进行了第四.7节所述分辨率调整噪音表的培训。 由此产生的全盘预测生成也遵循了瓦片推导程序.
C.4节规定了详细的微调程序。

blocks.en:
We show qualitative results in Figure 11 , which presents full-disk α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} predictions from the fine-tuned STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI models. We evaluate the models on data from 2024 February 22, 04:12 TAI, which falls within the test-set time range and is selected because the STEREO /EUVI field of view has substantial overlap with both SDO /HMI and GOES /SUVI. Across all three instruments, MAGiDiff recovers the dominant active-region magnetic structure and produces full-disk predictions that broadly resemble the SuperSynthIA reference.
Some disagreement remains in extended plage regions, where a bipolar structure may be predicted as unipolar, consistent with the limitation discussed in Section IV.7 .
blocks.zh:
我们在图11中显示了定性结果,图11提供了经过微调的STEREO/EUVI和GOES/SUVI模型的全盘α B R\alpha B_{R}预测. 我们评价2024年2月22日04:12 TAI的数据模型,该模型属于测试设定的时间范围,之所以选择该模型,是因为STEREO/EUVI视野与SDO/HMI和GOES/SUVI都有很大重叠. 在所有三种仪器中,MAGiDiff都回收了占支配地位的活区磁性结构,并产生了大致类似于SuperSynthIA参考的全磁盘预测.
一些分歧仍然存在于延伸区,根据第四节7所讨论的限制,两极结构可能预测为单极。

blocks.en: We additionally assess the distributional agreement between these full-disk predictions and the SuperSynthIA reference in Figure 19 . Because the predictions are inferred solely from EUV observations acquired by different instruments, whereas the SuperSynthIA reference is derived from SDO /HMI observations and reprojected onto each instrument’s respective coordinate grid, exact pixel-accurate correspondence is impossible. We therefore examine the pixel-value distributions to assess whether the models recover the overall distribution of magnetic field values. Across all instruments and field components, the predicted distributions broadly follow the corresponding SuperSynthIA distribution, with slight underestimation at strong field strengths, particularly for α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估这些全盘预测与图19中SuperSynthIa参考的分布协议. 由于预测完全来自不同仪器获得的EUV观测结果,而SuperSynthIA的参考来源于SDO/HMI观测结果,并重新投射到每个仪器各自的坐标网格上,因此准确的像素精确对应是不可能的. 因此,我们审查像素值分布,以评估模型是否恢复磁场值的整体分布。 在所有仪器和现场组件中,预测的分布大致遵循相应的SuperSynthIA分布,在强大的现场优势上略微低估,尤其是α B → α B → α B → α B → α B → α B → α Theta }。

blocks.en:
To isolate the effect of full-disk domain gap, we compare two inference settings in Figure 12 : applying MAGiDiff to the full-disk EUV input and then cropping the predicted magnetogram afterward, versus applying MAGiDiff directly to the corresponding EUV cutout. With tiled full-disk inference, the two settings produce similar results in both regions, and both recover the dominant magnetic structures well.
The zoom-ins also explain the underestimation of strong-field α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} pixels for the two GOES /SUVI predictions in Figure 19 . In both inference settings, MAGiDiff predicts a smaller sunspot than SuperSynthIA, resulting in substantial field strength underestimation for pixels near the sunspot boundary. This underestimation of the size of the active region is not too surprising, since the GOES /SUVI instruments only provide EUV information and have limited direct information about the photosphere. Nonetheless, the results demonstrate that tiled inference can extend the method across the full disk. More broadly, while the size of the active region in the GOES /SUVI data is smaller, its general shape and configuration are consistent with SuperSynthIA. Thus, the results suggest that MAGiDiff can be applied to a variety of UV/EUV instruments to produce estimates of the vector magnetic field.
blocks.zh:
为了隔离全磁盘域间隙的效果,我们比较了图12中的两个推论设置:将MAGiDiff应用到全磁盘的EUV输入,然后在之后裁剪预测的磁图,而将MAGiDiff直接应用到相应的EUV剪切. 有了瓦片的全磁盘推论,两个设置在两个区域都会产生相似的结果,两个区域都很好地恢复了主导磁结构.
缩放还解释了对图19中两个GOES/SUVI预测的强场α B → α B → α B → α b → α B → α B → α B → α B → α B → α B → βtheta → 像素的低估。 在两种推论设置中,MAGiDiff预测的太阳点比SuperSynthIa小,导致太阳点边界附近像素的实地强度被大量低估. 这种对活动区域规模的低估不足为奇,因为GOES/SUVI仪器只提供EUV信息,而且关于光圈的直接信息有限. 尽管如此,结果显示,平板推论可以将这种方法扩展到整个磁盘。 更广泛地说,GOES / SUVI数据中活动区域的大小虽然较小,但其一般形状和配置与SuperSynthIA一致. 因此,结果表明,MAGiDiff可以应用于各种紫外/EUV仪器,以得出矢量磁场的估计数.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: We present MAGiDiff , a new approach to estimate photospheric vector magnetic field directly from UV/EUV intensity maps using a deep learning model. MAGiDiff is built upon the latent diffusion model and is trained on co-registered SDO /AIA and Hinode /SOT-SP observations with 14 14 years of data. Inspired by prior works [ 36 , 30 , 64 ] , we extend the focus beyond line-of-sight magnetograms to the full heliographic vector magnetic field components α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} . Qualitative and quantitative evaluations show that MAGiDiff produces visually-plausible magnetograms. In cutouts, MAGiDiff predictions show strong agreement with Hinode /SOT-SP, capturing both the large-scale structure and fine details.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MAGiDiff, 一种使用深层学习模型直接从紫外线/EUV强度图中估算光球矢量磁场的新方法。 MAGiDiff是建立在潜在扩散模型之上的,并接受关于共同注册的SDO/AIA和Hinode/SOT-SP观测的培训,有14年的数据。 在以前作品[36、30、64]的启发下,我们把重点扩大到光线磁力图以外的全流体矢量磁场元件α B R α α B → α B → α → α B → α → α B → α → α → α B → α Theta } 定性和定量评价显示,MAGiDiff产生可视性的磁图. 在剪辑中,MAGiDiff预测显示与Hinode /SOT-SP的强烈一致,既捕捉了大规模结构,也捕捉了精细细节.

blocks.en: We propose methods to probe the model beyond standard prediction to examine the richer physical information embedded in the model’s predictive distribution. We further demonstrate that MAGiDiff can be adapted to other EUV instruments and shows promising generalization across solar cycles. Full-disk experiments show that MAGiDiff can recover the main active-region magnetic structure beyond Hinode /SOT-SP-sized cutouts, while also revealing the need for additional global context to resolve domain gaps.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一些方法来探索这个模型, 超越标准的预测, 来检查模型的预测分布中所包含的更丰富的物理信息。 我们进一步表明,MAGiDiff可以适应其他的欧盟V仪器,并显示出整个太阳周期的可喜普遍性。 全盘实验显示,MAGiDiff可以回收超过Hinode / SOT-SP大小剪切的主要活动区域磁性结构,同时也揭示了解决域间隙需要额外的全球背景.

blocks.en: Many of these results are credited to the breadth of data that is available for learning methods. Hinode /SOT-SP has provided nearly 19 years of high-quality data, and SDO /AIA has provided high-cadence, well-calibrated, full-disk filtergrams since 2010. This immense archive of data is absolutely critical for creating a high-quality dataset for training.
blocks.zh: 许多这些结果都归功于可供学习方法使用的数据的广度。 Hinode / SOT-SP提供了近19年的高质量数据,SDO /AIA自2010年起提供了高清,校准精良的全碟滤镜. 这种庞大的数据档案对建立高质量培训数据集绝对至关重要。

blocks.en:
Meanwhile, deep learning has unlocked huge potential in solar physics. Traditionally, vector magnetograms can only be inferred using inversion methods like [ 47 , 5 ] , which require high quality Stokes profiles. These full Stokes profiles are hard to acquire as a spectropolarimeter is required and typically can only be measured with limited cadence and coverage. By contrast, EUV intensity imaging is easier and therefore more common and spans over multiple solar cycles.
Several studies have demonstrated that models can reasonably infer magnetograms from UV/EUV intensity images, despite the only statistical relationship between UV/EUV intensity and magnetic field maps. Among these efforts, [ 36 ] was the first to propose using a conditional GAN to estimate LOS magnetogram from EUV intensity images. Subsequent works - [ 30 , 10 , 64 , 33 , 16 , 44 , 29 , 31 ] - experimented with inputs from various instruments and introduced refinements to the GAN structure like incorporating temporal consistency and multi-channel conditioning. More recently, Ramunno et al. [51] , Ramunno et al. [52] , Xu et al. [72] bring diffusion into the field but their work primarily focuses on super-resolution of LOS magnetograms and conditional solar image generation. To the best of our knowledge, MAGiDiff is the first diffusion-based model to estimate full heliographic vector magnetic field end-to-end from EUV observations. We further probe the model to characterize the physical correlation it learns. We also test cross-instrument transfer to STEREO /EUVI and GOES /SUVI, where MAGiDiff shows good generalization ability, suggesting a potential extension to other similar instruments with careful calibration.
blocks.zh:
与此同时,深入的学习释放了太阳物理学的巨大潜力。 传统上,向量磁图只能使用反转法来推断,如[47,5],它们需要高质量的斯托克斯剖面. 由于需要光谱极度计,因此很难获得这些完整的Stokes剖面图,而且通常只能用有限的宽度和覆盖度来衡量。 相比之下,EUV强度成像比较容易,因此更为常见,跨越多个太阳周期.
有几项研究表明,尽管紫外线/紫外线强度图与磁场图之间仅有统计关系,但模型仍可从紫外线/紫外线强度图中合理推断出磁力图。 在这些努力中,[36]首先提议使用有条件的GAN从EUV强度图像中估算LOS磁图. 随后的作品 - [30, 10, 64, 33, 16, 44, 29, 31] - 尝试了各种仪器的投入,并对GAN结构进行了改进,如纳入时间一致性和多通道调节. 最近,拉蒙诺等人. [51], Ramunno等人著. [52],徐等人[72]将传播带入了领域,但他们的工作主要侧重于LOS磁图的超分辨率和有条件的太阳图像生成. 据我们所知,MAGiDiff是第一个基于扩散的模型,从EUV观测中估算出完全的直升机向量磁场端到端. 我们进一步探索模型 来描述它学到的物理相关性 我们还测试跨仪器传输到STEREO/EUVI和GOES/SUVI,其中MAGiDiff表现出良好的概括性能力,建议通过仔细校准,有可能扩展到其他类似仪器.

blocks.en:
Despite its strong performance, MAGiDiff naturally inherits several limitations due to its data-driven methodology. First, it depends critically on the accurate co-registration between SDO /AIA UV/EUV intensity map and Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms. This is difficult as SDO /AIA captures data near instantaneously while Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms are built up over tens of minutes. Such a temporal disparity means that UV/EUV observation can change dramatically while magnetogram data is being produced, leading to natural mismatch between the pairs. Second, MAGiDiff is trained on small, activity-focused cutouts. When applied at full-disk scale, this crop-based training can lead to artifacts like overly coherent unipolar large-scale plage. These failure modes suggest that full-disk prediction requires additional global context beyond what is available in the training cutouts.
Third, although the model is provided with a polarity prior that should help resolve the polarity ambiguity, polarity errors can still occur. In many of these failure cases, different MAGiDiff realizations sample both the correct polarity solution and its sign-flipped counterpart. In other cases, however, the model consistently selects the opposite polarity. These cases indicate that resolving polarity remains imperfect in the current model and could be improved in future work.
blocks.zh:
尽管其性能很强,但MAGiDiff因其数据驱动方法而自然继承了几个局限性. 首先,这主要取决于SDO/AIAU/EUV强度图和Hinode/SOT-SP磁图之间的准确共登记。 这很困难,因为SDO /AIA在Hinode /SOT-SP磁力图积聚在数十分钟的时间里时会瞬间捕捉到数据. 这种时间差异意味着紫外线/EUV观测值在磁学数据生成时会发生巨大变化,导致对对子之间的自然不匹配. 第二,MAGiDiff接受关于以活动为重点的小规模断电的培训。 这种以作物为主的训练在全面应用时,可产生诸如过于连贯的单极大规模插板等文物。 这些失败模式表明,全面预测需要超越培训停课时可用的其他全球背景。
第三,虽然该模型先有极性,应有助于解决极性模糊问题,但极性错误仍然可能发生。 在许多这些故障中,不同的MAGiDiff实现同时对正确的极性溶液及其标志性闪烁的对应物进行抽样. 但在其他情况下,该模型始终选择相反的极性. 这些案件表明,解决极性问题在目前模式中仍然是不完善的,可在今后的工作中加以改进。

blocks.en: Nonetheless, MAGiDiff shows the opportunity to generate estimates of the vector magnetic field from other instruments. In combination with other advances in solar physics, we hope to extend the availability of high-quality data.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,MAGiDiff显示了从其他仪器生成矢量磁场估计数的机会. 结合太阳物理学的其他进展,我们希望扩大高质量数据的提供。

blocks.en: Appendix A Diffusion Model Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩散模型细节

blocks.en: Diffusion models lay the foundation for this work, and in this section we provide a concise overview of the underlying framework. We begin with an introduction of the classical formulation of the forward and reverse processes in the original denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM, [ 26 ] ), which defines the basic mechanism of gradually adding and removing noise. Building on that, we then introduce refinements that are central to our implementation.
blocks.zh: 传播模式为这项工作奠定了基础,我们在本节简要概述了基本框架。 我们首先在最初的去诺化扩散概率模型(DDPM,[26])中引入了前向和反向过程的经典配体,它定义了逐渐添加和去除噪声的基本机制. 在此基础上,我们接着提出对我们执行工作至关重要的改进措施。

blocks.en: A.1 Forward and Reverse Process
blocks.zh: A.1 前进和逆转进程

blocks.en: In the classical DDPM, the generative process is defined by a pair of Markov chains: a forward noising process that gradually perturbs clean data into noise, and a reverse denoising process that gradually removes noise to recover clean samples.

blocks.en: A.3 DDIM sampling
blocks.zh: A.3 DDIM 取样

blocks.en: Whereas DDPM reverse process defines a stochastic Markov chain with Gaussian noise injected at every denoising step, [ 62 ] introduced Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM): a deterministic, non-Markovian sampling procedure that uses the same trained denoising network but eliminates per-step noise injection. blocks.en: A.4 Latent Diffusion
blocks.zh: A.4 后期扩散

blocks.en: Applying diffusion directly in pixel space is computationally demanding, as high-dimensional images require large memory and long training times. In addition, pixel space encodes redundant high-frequency variations and sensor noise that are perceptually uninformative, forcing the model to waste capacity on irrelevant details.
blocks.zh: 在像素空间直接应用扩散在计算上要求很高,因为高维度图像需要大量的内存和长时间的训练时间. 此外,像素空间还编码了多余的高频变异和感应噪声,这些噪声在感知上是不灵异的,迫使模型在无关细节上浪费能力.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, Latent Diffusion Models (LDM; [ 54 ] ) first compress images into a lower-dimensional latent space using a variational autoencoder (VAE; [ 37 ] ), and then perform the forward and reverse diffusion process in that latent space. A VAE is an encoder-decoder structure: the encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} maps input images 𝐱 \mathbf{x} into a compressed latent representation 𝐳 = ℰ ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{z}=\mathcal{E}(\mathbf{x}) , and the decoder 𝒟 \mathcal{D} reconstructs the image from its latent 𝐱 ^ = 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝐳 ) \hat{\mathbf{x}}=\mathcal{D}(\mathbf{z}) . The autoencoder is trained independently first using reconstruction loss and regularization, ensuring that the latent representation preserves semantic content while remaining smooth.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,Latent Difusion Models(LDM;[54])首先使用变异自编码器(VAE;[37])将图像压缩成一个低维潜在空间,然后在该潜在空间进行前向和反向扩散过程。 VAE是一个编码器-解码器结构:编码器E\mathcal{E}将输入图像x\mathbf{x}映射到压缩的潜伏代表z=E__(x)\mathbf{z_mathcal{(\mathbf{x}),解码器D\mathcal{D}从其潜伏的x__(z)\h\mathb{×Mathcal{D}重建图像. 自动编码器首先通过重建损失和规范化进行独立培训,确保潜在表示保留语义内容,同时保持平滑。

blocks.en: Once the VAE is trained and frozen, the diffusion processes operate entirely in latent space, with the image variable 𝐱 \mathbf{x} replaced by its latent representation 𝐳 \mathbf{z} . blocks.en: This latent diffusion formulation combines the representational power of autoencoders with the generative flexibility of diffusion models. By shifting the diffusion process into a compressed latent space, it reduces computational cost, improves scalability to high-resolution data, and enhances model’s knowledge on semantically meaningful information. As a result, LDMs achieve better efficiency and robustness, making it a good foundation for MAGiDiff .
blocks.zh: 这种潜在的扩散配体结合了自动编码器的表达力和扩散模型的基因灵活性. 通过将扩散过程转换为压缩的潜在空间,可以降低计算成本,提高高分辨率数据的可扩展性,增强模型对精密信息的知识。 因此,LDM提高了效率和稳健性,成为MAGiDiff的良好基础.

blocks.en: C.2 Additional Stochastic Sampling Results
blocks.zh: C.2 额外抽样结果

blocks.en: The evaluations presented in Section IV.4 use one realization per input in order to compare MAGiDiff directly with the deterministic regression baseline. However, as a conditional diffusion model, MAGiDiff encodes a distribution of plausible magnetograms and is inherently stochastic: for a fixed UV/EUV conditioning input, different initial noise can yield different realizations drawn from the learned distribution. In this section, we examine this distribution through qualitative comparisons of independent realizations and a quantitative best-of- k k analysis.
blocks.zh: 第四.4节提出的评价使用每个投入一个实现,以便直接将MAGiDiff与确定性回归基线进行比较。 然而,作为有条件的传播模型,MAGiDiff编码了一种假想磁图的分布,并具有内在的色谱性:对于固定的紫外线/EUV调制输入,不同的初始噪声可以产生来自所学分布的不同实现. 在本节中,我们通过对独立实现的定性比较和对k的定量最佳分析来审查这种分布。

blocks.en: C.2.1 Qualitative Comparison between Realizations
blocks.zh: C.2.1 实现额之间的定性比较

blocks.en: We begin with qualitative comparison of these realizations to determine where magnetic structures remain consistent and where stochastic variations occur. Figure 17 shows three independent realizations drawn from the same UV/EUV observations. The realizations recover almost identical large scale magnetic structures and polarity across α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , and α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} , indicating that the dominant magnetic structures are well constrained. Meanwhile, small differences appear in localized weak-field regions, reflecting the stochastic nature of diffusion sampling process. This behavior suggests that MAGiDiff does not produce arbitrary samples, but instead generates multiple plausible magnetograms that remain consistent in well-constrained regions while allowing variation when the signal is weak or uncertain.

blocks.en: Given this constrained variation across realizations, we next use a best-of- k k analysis to test whether drawing more samples increases the chance of obtaining a realization that more closely matches the Hinode /SOT-SP ground truth. Table 6 reports this evaluation using the same metrics and evaluation method as Table 2 . For each sample in the test set, we draw k k independent MAGiDiff realizations and evaluate the realization with smallest error relative to the Hinode /SOT-SP ground truth.
blocks.zh: 鉴于各种实现的这种受限差异,我们接下来将使用最优KK分析来测试绘制更多样本是否增加了获得更接近Hinode/SOT-SP地面真相的认知的机会. 表6采用与表2相同的衡量和评价方法报告本次评价。 对于测试集中的每个样本,我们绘制k k 独立的 MAGiDiff 实现,并相对于 Hinode / SOT-SP 地面真理以最小的误差来评价实现.

blocks.en:
This best-of- k k evaluation is not intended to represent normal inference, where the ground truth is unavailable. Rather, it is a controlled test of the learned predictive distribution: if MAGiDiff places probability mass near the ground truth magnetogram, then drawing more samples should increase the chance of obtaining a realization closer to the Hinode /SOT-SP ground truth. This trend is confirmed in Table 6 : increasing k k leads to consistent improvements in pixel-wise accuracy across all field components.
In contrast, the distributional and structural metrics remain largely unchanged. These results indicate that additional sampling can increase the possibility of obtaining a realization that has better per-pixel correspondence with the Hinode /SOT-SP observation while keeping the overall pixel-value distribution, sharpness, and spectral characteristics. Together with Figure 17 , these results show that stochastic variations among realizations permit generalization of multiple slightly different yet distributionally and structurally constrained magnetograms.
