blocks.en: C.4 Cross-Instrument Fine-Tuning Pipeline
blocks.zh: C.4 交叉文书 微调管道

blocks.en:
To adapt MAGiDiff to EUV instruments other than SDO /AIA, we keep the learning problem fixed and handle instrumental differences during preprocessing. This preprocessing aims to bring each instrument’s EUV filtergrams into closer agreement with SDO /AIA filtergrams before fine-tuning. For each instrument, we first reproject all filtergrams onto a common grid and resample them to reduce pixel-resolution mismatch with SDO /AIA. We then calibrate the intensities to approximately the SDO /AIA range and set unavailable SDO /AIA channels to zero.
The fine-tuned model therefore receives the same conditioning input: SDO /AIA-like EUV filtergrams, an on-disk mask, a heliographic latitude map, and a solar cycle indicator.
blocks.zh:
为了使MAGiDiff适应除SDO/AIA之外的EUV仪器,我们在预处理过程中保持学习问题的固定和处理工具差异. 此预处理旨在使每个仪器的EUV滤镜在微调前与SDO/AIA滤镜更接近协议. 对于每个仪器,我们首先将所有滤波器重新投影到一个共同的网格上,并重新做成它们,以减少像素分辨率与SDO /AIA的不匹配. 然后,我们把强度校准到大约SDO/AIA范围,并将无法使用的SDO/AIA频道设定为零。
因此,微调模型得到相同的条件输入:SDO/AIA类似EUV滤镜,一个盘面罩,一个直升机纬度图,以及一个太阳周期指标.

blocks.en: Since Hinode /SOT-SP does not co-observe STEREO /EUVI or GOES /SUVI densely enough for paired training, we use SuperSynthIA predictions as the target vector magnetograms. For each EUV observation, we take the nearest SuperSynthIA α ​ B R \alpha B_{R} , α ​ B ϕ \alpha B_{\phi} , α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} maps and reproject them onto the corresponding EUV filtergram grid. Because SuperSynthIA follows SDO /HMI α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} sign convention, a flip on SuperSynthIA α ​ B θ \alpha B_{\theta} sign is necessary after reprojection to match the Hinode /SOT-SP convention used by the pretrained MAGiDiff .
blocks.zh: 由于Hinode /SOT-SP没有共同观测STEREO /EUVI或GOES /SUVI的密度足以进行配对训练,我们使用SuperSynthIA的预测作为目标矢量磁图. 对于每个EUV观察,我们取最近的SuperSynthIa α B R\alpha B_{R}, α B → alpha B_{\phi}, α B → alpha B_{\theta} 地图并重投射到相应的EUV过滤格网. 因为SuperSynthIA遵循了SDO /HMI α B →\alpha B_{\theta}签定公约,所以在重新投射后,需要给SuperSynthIA α B →\alpha B_{\theta}签一个翻转的签,以与预先训练的MAGiDiff使用的Hinode /SOT-SP公约相匹配.

blocks.en: Fine-tuning proceeds in two stages. We first fine-tune the VAE on 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixel SuperSynthIA vector magnetogram crops so that its latent space is adapted to SuperSynthIA predictions rather than Hinode /SOT-SP magnetograms. This corresponds to approximately 153 ​ ″ × 153 ​ ″ 153\arcsec\times 153\arcsec . We then load the pretrained denoising U-Net, replace the original VAE with the SuperSynthIA fine-tuned VAE, reset the optimizer, and fine-tune on instrument-specific pairs of EUV filtergrams and target magnetograms using 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel crops, corresponding to approximately 306 ​ ″ × 306 ​ ″ 306\arcsec\times 306\arcsec , while keeping the VAE frozen. Otherwise, the denoising training setup is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 精细调整分两个阶段进行. 我们首先在256×256 256\times 256像素 SuperSynthIa 矢量磁学作物上对VAE进行微调,使其潜在空间适应SuperSynthIa的预测,而不是Hinode / SOT-SP磁学. 这相当于约153 × 153 × 153\arcsec\times 153\arcsec。 然后加载预装脱氧的U-Net,将原来的VAE替换为SuperSynthIa精制的VAE,重置优化器,并用512×512 512\时的512\时的512像素作物对仪器专用的EUV滤镜和目标磁图进行微调,对应约306××306\arcsec\时的306\arcsec,同时保持VAE冻结. 否则,授意训练设置不变.

blocks.en: During fine-tuning, we also use a sign-flip augmentation analogous to the one used in the cross solar cycle generalization test in Section IV.6 . With probability 0.5 0.5 , the target vector magnetogram is multiplied by − 1 -1 and the solar cycle indicator is changed from the current cycle parity to the opposite parity, while the EUV filtergrams and latitude map remain unchanged. This augmentation is included because instrument-specific fine-tuning datasets are relatively small and may not span multiple solar cycles. The remaining preprocessing is instrument specific.
blocks.zh: 在微调期间,我们还采用类似于第四节6中跨太阳周期一般化试验中使用的标志-滑动增强法。 概率为0.5 0.5,目标矢量磁力图乘以−1-1,太阳周期指标由目前的周期平面改为相反平面,而EUV滤镜和纬度图则保持不变. 列入这种增强的原因是仪器专用微调数据集相对较小,可能不会跨越多个太阳周期。 其余的预处理为仪器专用.

blocks.en: C.4.1 Adaption to STEREO /EUVI
blocks.zh: C.4.1 适应STEREO/欧盟VI

blocks.en: Intuitively, directly applying MAGiDiff trained on SDO /AIA data to STEREO /EUVI filtergrams will not work due to instrumental differences in field of view, optical resolution, calibration, and degradation. We therefore make several adjustments before fine-tuning. We use data from 2022 to 2024 to construct the fine-tuning dataset because during this period STEREO-A /EUVI is near Earth and has substantial field-of-view overlap with SDO /HMI. This overlap is essential because we use SuperSynthIA predictions as the target vector magnetograms, and SDO /HMI stokes observations are the input to SuperSynthIA.
blocks.zh: 直觉上,直接将接受过SDO/AIA数据培训的MAGiDiff应用到STEREO/EUVI滤镜上,由于在视野,光学分辨率,校准,降解等方面的工具性差异,将失效. 因此,我们在微调之前作出若干调整。 我们使用2022年至2024年的数据来构建微调数据集,因为在此期间STEREO-A/EUVI位于地球附近,并且与SDO/HMI有着大量的视场重叠. 这种重叠是必要的,因为我们使用SuperSynthIA预测作为目标矢量磁图,SDO/HMI stokes观测是SuperSynthIA的输入.

blocks.en: For the fine-tuning dataset, we use 171 171 Å, 195 195 Å, and 304 304 Å  channels because they are the STEREO /EUVI passbands that overlap with SDO /AIA passbands. We sample candidate times at a 4 4 -hour cadence and, because these channels are observed asynchronously on STEREO /EUVI, retain only timestamps for which all three channels are available within 5 5 minutes. Raw Level- 0.5 0.5 FITS files are calibrated to Level- 1 1 with SECCHI_PREP pipeline in SolarSoft package [ 14 ] , which applies bias subtraction, flat-field correction, and are converted to physical units DN s − 1 \text{\,}\mathrm{DN}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} . We then reproject the 195 195 Å  and 304 304 Å  maps onto the 171 171 Å  coordinate frame and bilinearly upsample the resulting maps by a factor of 2.67 × 2.67\times to match SDO /AIA’s angular pixel scale. We then reproject the SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms onto this upsampled grid. After filtering for valid paired full-disk EUV filtergrams and SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms, the STEREO /EUVI fine-tuning dataset contains 4949 4949 pairs. We split these data temporally: 2022 2022 January through 2023 2023 June for training ( 2938 2938 pairs), 2023 2023 July through December for validation ( 523 523 pairs), and 2024 2024 April through December for testing ( 1488 1488 pairs).
blocks.zh: 在微调数据集方面,我们使用171 171 Ö、195 195 Ö和304 304 Ö频道,因为它们是STEREO/EUVI的通过带,与SDO/AIA的通过带重叠。 我们在4个4小时的考生时间进行抽样,由于这些频道在STEREO/EUVI上同步观测,因此仅保留时间戳,所有三个频道在5分钟内都可以使用。 Raw Level - 0.5 0.5 FITS文件在SolarSoft包中与SECCHI_PREP管道校准为-1 1,该程序应用偏差减法,平面校正,并转换为物理单元 DN s − 1\text ~, }\ mathrm{ DN}\text →, }{\ }{\ }{\1}. 然后,我们将195、195、304、304 的地图重新投影到171、171 的坐标架上,用2.67×2.67的倍数对地图进行双线式的取样,以与SDO/AIA的角像素比例相匹配。 然后我们重新投影 超级合成IA矢量磁力图 在这个被检测的网格。 在对有效配对的EUV滤镜和SuperSynthIA矢量磁力图进行过滤后,STEREO/EUVI微调数据集包含494949对. 我们按时间划分这些数据:2022年1月2022日至2023年6月2023日进行训练(2938 2938对),2023年2023年 7月至12月进行验证(523,523对),2024年4月至12月进行测试(1488,1488对).

blocks.en: The main STEREO /EUVI-specific challenge is photometric mismatch. The paired STEREO /EUVI– SDO /AIA intensity distributions are not well matched by a single affine correction, especially in the bright active-region and low-intensity tails. This mismatch is further complicated by long-term STEREO /EUVI degradation: the SECCHI_PREP pipeline calibrates the raw data to Level-1, but it does not fully remove long-term changes in instrument sensitivity, so the STEREO /EUVI intensity distribution can vary substantially over the mission. We therefore use a time-varying quantile mapping in log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) space. The mapping is estimated from about 10 10 calibration pairs per available month from 2011 2011 through 2025 2025 . Each pair consists of STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA observations taken close in time. We exclude September 2014 through November 2015 because STEREO-A /EUVI was in solar conjunction and data are unavailable. This leaves 1606 1606 calibration pairs. For each pair, the on-disk pixels are sorted by intensity separately for STEREO /EUVI and SDO /AIA. The 0 0 th, 1 1 st, …, 100 100 th percentiles of these sorted intensity values are then recorded for each STEREO /EUVI-to-aia channel pair ( STEREO /EUVI 171 171 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 171 171 Å, STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 193 193 Å, and STEREO /EUVI 304 304 Å → \rightarrow SDO /AIA 304 304 Å). These percentiles form the raw calibration anchors for the lookup table by matching intensity values at the same percentile rank in the two instruments. For example, if the median on-disk STEREO /EUVI 195 195 Å  intensity in a calibration pair is x x and the median on-disk SDO /AIA 193 193 Å  intensity in the corresponding SDO /AIA filtergram is y y , then the 50 50 th-percentile anchor maps x ↦ y x\mapsto y . The same procedure is applied to all percentiles, so the mapping matches the full intensity distribution.
blocks.zh: STEREO/EUVI特有的主要挑战是光度不匹配. 配对的STEREO / EUVI – SDO /AIA 强度分布不完全匹配单一的亲缘校正,尤其是在亮亮的活跃区和低强度尾部. 这种不匹配因长期的STEREO/EUVI退化而进一步复杂化:SECCHI_PREP管道将原始数据校准到一级,但并没有完全消除仪器灵敏度的长期变化,因此STEREO/EUVI的强度分布在整个任务中可以有很大的差异. 因此,我们在log QX (1 + x)\log (1 + x) 空间中使用一个时间变化的四进制映射 。 据估计,从2011年到2025年,每个可用月约有10对校准对。 每对观测由及时采集的STEREO/EUVI和SDO/AIA观测组成。 我们把2014年9月至2015年11月排除在外,因为STEREO-A/EUVI是太阳并联的,而且没有数据。 这留下了1606,1606的校准对. 对于每对,在磁盘上的像素按强度分别排序为STEREO/EUVI和SDO/AIA. 然后记录每对STEREO/EUVI对AIA通道对的零分数、11分数、100百分数(STEREO/EUVI 171 Å → → → \ \ / / / / / /  171 STER STER → → → → → → \ \ \ \ IA IA IA IA IA IA IA IA IA STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER STER 这些百分位通过匹配两个仪器中同一百分位的强度值,形成原始校准锚点。 例如,如果一个校准对对中盘上的中位数STEREO / EUVI 195 Å的强度为xx,而相应的SDO /AIA滤镜中盘上的中位数为 y 193 Å的强度为 y,那么50 百分位锚图 x y x\ mapsto y. 同样的程序适用于所有百分位数,因此映射与全强度分布相符.

blocks.en: The calibration anchors are grouped into semiannual time bins. Within each bin and each channel pair, the matched percentile values are median-aggregated to form a stable lookup curve from STEREO /EUVI intensity to SDO /AIA intensity. The curves are smoothed with a three-bin rolling median, and monotonicity is enforced. This produces a lookup curve with 101 101 breakpoints.
blocks.zh: 校准锚被组合成半年时间盒. 在每个 bin 和每个通道对齐中,匹配的百分位值为中位总和,以形成从 STEREO / EUVI 强度到 SSO / AIA 强度的稳定望曲线. 曲线采用三机滚动中位数平滑,单调执行. 这产生了一个有101个101个断点的望向曲线.

blocks.en: To map a STEREO /EUVI intensity value, we first apply log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) and then linearly interpolate between the neighboring breakpoints, using linear extrapolation for values outside the stored breakpoint range. This places the STEREO /EUVI values on the same log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) intensity scale as the SDO /AIA inputs used to pretrain MAGiDiff . After this transform, training proceeds with standard SDO /AIA normalization.
blocks.zh: 要映射一个 STEREO / EUVI 强度值,我们首先应用log QQ (1 + x)\log(1+x),然后在相邻断点之间线性插值,对存储断点范围以外的值使用线性推算. 这使得 STEREO / EUVI 值与用于预导 MAgiDiff 的 STEREO /AIA 输入值位于 QQ( 1 + x )\log( 1 + x ) 强度尺度上 。 在这一转变之后,培训将随着标准SDO/AIA的正常化而进行。

blocks.en: This correction reduces the dominant distribution shift associated STEREO /EUVI degradation, but it does not make the model equally reliable at all observation times. Because the fine-tuning dataset is restricted to observation from 2022 2022 through 2024 2024 , when STEREO-A /EUVI has substantial overlap with SDO /HMI, we expect the fine-tuned MAGiDiff model to be most reliable near this time range. Applying the model to much earlier STEREO /EUVI observations may therefore require additional adjustment, either by extending the fine-tuning dataset to earlier observations or by improving the calibration for long-term STEREO /EUVI intensity changes.
blocks.zh: 这种校正减少了与STEREO/EUVI相关的主分布转移,但并不使模型在所有观测时间都同样可靠. 由于微调数据集仅限于2022年2022年到2024年的观测,当STEREO-A /EUVI与SDO /HMI有实质性重叠时,我们预计微调后的MAGiDiff模型在这个时间范围附近最可靠. 因此,将模型应用到更早的STEREO/EUVI观测中可能需要额外的调整,要么将微调数据集扩展至更早的观测,要么改进长期STEREO/EUVI强度变化的校准.

blocks.en: As a second cross-instrument adaption test, we fine-tune MAGiDiff on the Solar Ultraviolet Imager (SUVI) onboard GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI.
blocks.zh: 作为第二次跨仪器适配测试,我们在GOES – 16/SUVI和GOES – 18/SUVI上的太阳紫外线成像仪(SUVI)上微调了MAGiDiff.

blocks.en: For the fine-tuning dataset, we use 94 94 Å, 131 131 Å, 171 171 Å, 195 195 Å, and 304 304 Å  channels since they are the passbands that overlap with SDO /AIA passbands. We sample the Level-2 FITS products at a 4 4 -hour cadence and require all selected channels to be observed within 10 10 minutes from each other. For each timestamp, the five GOES /SUVI filtergrams are coaligned to the 171 171 Å  coordinate frame and then bilinearly upsampled by 4.17 × 4.17\times to match SDO /AIA’s angular pixel scale. We then reproject the SuperSynthIA vector magnetograms onto the upsampled GOES /SUVI grid.
blocks.zh: 在微调数据集方面,我们使用94 94 o、131 o、171 171 o、195 195 o和304 304 o 频道,因为它们是同SDO/AIA密码带重叠的通过带。 我们以4个4小时的频率对2级FITS产品进行取样,并要求在10分钟之内观察所有选定的通道。 每个时标,GOES/SUVI滤镜的5个均与171 171 Å坐标框对齐,然后用4.17×4.17\时标进行双线性提升取样,以匹配SDO/AIA的角像素尺度. 然后我们重新投影 SuperSynthIa 矢量磁力图 上取样 GOES / SUVI 网格。

blocks.en: The fine-tuning dataset spans 2022 2022 through 2024 2024 and contains 7475 7475 data pairs across GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI. After filtering, the train/validation/test datasets contain 3160 3160 / 1231 1231 / 2208 2208 samples. As in the STEREO /EUVI fine-tuning experiment, we split the data temporally: 2022 2022 January through 2023 2023 June for training, 2023 2023 July through December for validation, and 2024 2024 April through December for testing.
blocks.zh: 微调数据集跨度为2022 2022年到2024年,包含7475 745个数据对,横跨GOES–16/SUVI和GOES–18/SUVI. 过滤后,列车/验证/测试数据集包含3160 3160 / 1231 1231 / 2208 2208 样本. 和STEREO/EUVI微调实验一样,我们按时间划分数据:2022年1月2022日至2023年1月20日 2023年6月参加训练 7月至12月进行验证,2024年4月2024日至12月进行测试.

blocks.en: We use the calibrated Level-2 products directly and normalize the inputs in log ⁡ ( 1 + x ) \log(1+x) space. Since the two satellites are not fully intercalibrated, we compute separate per-channel means and standard deviations for GOES–16 /SUVI and GOES–18 /SUVI. Fine-tuning is then performed on combined data pairs from both satellites, with each sample normalized using the parameters for its source satellite.
blocks.zh: 我们直接使用校准的二级产品,并规范对数 {} (1 + x)\log(1 + x) 空格中的输入. 由于这两颗卫星没有完全相互校准,我们计算GOES – 16/SUVI和GOES – 18/SUVI的每个信道的单独手段和标准偏差。 然后在两颗卫星的合并数据对上进行微调,每个样本都使用其源卫星的参数实现正常化。
